About Shortcut

Our mission is to ensure software development teams can do their best work. Shortcut is the project management platform that teams actually want to use: fast, intuitive, and lightweight enough to stay out of the way while keeping everything moving.

With Korey, our agentic AI layer, we're going further: automatically surfacing context, structuring work across tools, and keeping teams in the loop. We're building Shortcut and Korey around a simple belief: the future of software development is people and agents working side-by-side, on one platform.

We're a remote-first company with a lean, experienced team. We move fast, trust people to make good calls, and communicate openly. We care about the craft of what we build, and we think software that's genuinely enjoyable to use is worth the effort it takes to get there.

The Role

We're a product development team where everyone ships. You should be excited to work as someone who produces product experiences through design and shipping code. You’ll work closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams.

You should be a product designer who moves fluidly from developing features in Figma and Claude to implementing them in code, shortening the path from concept to production.

You thrive on moving from concept to implementation, iterating based on real user feedback, and refining experiences through hands-on experimentation. You sweat the details of interaction design, understand how modern AI products behave in practice, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers while contributing directly to the codebase. You're excited by designing repeatable patterns that make complex AI workflows feel intuitive, reliable, and enjoyable to use.

How We Work

We’re building the project management platform for software teams and their agents, and we work that way ourselves. Agentic tools are part of everyday life at Shortcut: we expect you to use them alongside your expertise and experience as a designer to ideate, prototype, and ship.

This part of our industry is evolving fast, and we support our team with dedicated funds and time to learn, experiment, and share best practices as a team. The craft here is moving up the stack: less time pushing pixels, and more time using your design judgment and strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • Contribute to product design across our products, from early concepts to shipped experiences
  • Prototype quickly, and take ideas from an idea to a working build
  • Use AI to sharpen the design process itself, not just to move faster

Who We Are

Founded in 2016, Rhombus is on a mission to make the world a safer place with our centralized platform that combines intelligent cameras, sensors, and AI analytics to help organizations improve safety and operations at scale. We have a solid product-market fit, customers love us, and our solution makes a profound impact and difference in the world.
Rhombus was created by industry veterans and is also backed by incredible investors who believe in transforming the world of physical security with enterprise-grade technology that's accessible to any organization.

Who You Are

Here at Rhombus, everyone plays a critical role in achieving our mission to make the world safer with simple, smart, and powerful physical security solutions. No matter what team you’re on, the work you do here makes a positive impact across the globe.
Rhombus is looking for a Commercial Account Executive who is passionate about selling, and owning the majority of the sales cycle, from qualification to close. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, tenacious, confident, with a willingness to engage in prospecting to maintain individual funnels as expected. You’ll collaborate closely with Marketing, Engineering and Product teams to act as a subject matter expert on Rhombus cameras and software.
This is an evergreen role. We encourage you to apply to be considered for future opportunities on our team as we continue to grow.

What You'll Do:

  • Manage the full sales cycle including prospecting and outreach to new customers, product demos, product trials, and strategic negotiations with customers and channel partners
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of Rhombus’ products as new hardware and features are released
  • Grow and maintain close relationships with Channel Managers and Channel Partners within a territory
  • Consistently exceed quarterly sales quota and maintain pipeline to support selling over quota
  • Provide feedback to Rhombus’ hardware, engineering, and development teams

What We're Looking For:

  • 3-5 years of B2B channel experience with a consistent track record of exceeding sales quotas
  • Proven ability to manage competitive and strategic sales efforts within SMB/Mid-Market
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills when working with peers, customers, and partners
  • Proficient in strategic outbound prospecting with a focus on business development through channel
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Chili Piper, Zoom, and Dialpad is a plus
  • Strong team collaboration skills with internal cross-functional departments
  • Open to travel for client engagements, such as meetings and events, and team gatherings

Location

This is a remote position. Candidates must be located in the Central part of the United States.

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring sponsorship now or in the future.

Compensation

Base Salary: $70,000-$80,000
Estimated OTE (base salary + commission): $140,000-$160,000
Additional forms of compensation, depending on the role, include uncapped commission, sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and equity in the company. Individual pay is determined based on the candidate's primary work/hiring location and additional factors, such as skills and experience, and relevant education, certifications, or training. Further details about compensation for the role can be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

Competitive Salary & Equity Options
Flexible Schedule & Paid-Time Off
Excellent Healthcare Coverage
Generous Family Leave Policy
WFH & Workspace Supplies
Career Growth & Professional Development
Dog-Friendly Office & Pet Insurance

What We Value

Customers Come First: We're obsessed with improving our users' lives and constantly question how we can improve upon what already exists.
One Team:Innovating in the physical security industry can't be accomplished by just a single person, which is why we collaborate with exceptional individuals who inspire us to be our best.
Think Greater: We believe the best ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to create an open environment where individuals can contribute and make an impact.
Act with Integrity:We believe honest communication is key to success. We conduct business the way it should be - with high ethical standards and to always do what's right.
Rhombus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. raw.description:
GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S.Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped consumers save nearly $75 billion on the cost of their prescriptions.

Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.

About the Role:

We are seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Sr. Digital Experience Specialist to enhance digital journeys for GoodRx’s priority growth areas, including Companion, Weight Loss Subscriptions, and other key business lines. In this role, you will translate business goals, customer insights, and performance data into actionable conversion rate optimization (CRO) and digital experience roadmap, You will work independently and partner across Marketing, Product, Design, Analytics, Engineering, SEO, CRM, and Legal to deliver effective digital experiences and measurable results..


Role & Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & Roadmap: Define digital experience strategies for assigned business lines and manage a prioritized CRO and landing-page roadmap.
  • Optimization: Drive continuous optimization for landing pages and merchandising modules while ensuring messaging continuity across all channels.
  • Experimentation & Analytics: Design, launch, and analyze A/B and multivariate experiments (e.g., using Optimizely) and utilize analytics (e.g., Amplitude, Lookr) to generate actionable insights.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the point of contact for CRO, landing page, and upsell development within Marketing. Partner closely with Marketing and Product leads to ensure testing plans and designs meet evolving business objectives and product/campaign needs.
  • AI Integration: Implement repeatable AI-enabled workflows for research, content creation, and process improvement while upholding legal and brand standards. Communicate findings, recommendations, and results to cross-functional stakeholders and adapt approaches based on business needs and performance data.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Business, Design, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in digital experience, growth marketing, or related digital disciplines.
  • Proven ability to lead digital strategy and landing-page optimization across multiple channels.
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing and user-centered design.
  • Hands-on experience with experimentation platforms (e.g., Optimizely) and analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Google Analytics, Looker).
  • Proficiency with enterprise CMS (e.g., Contentful) and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Airtable).
  • Excellent analytical, project management, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in subscription, healthcare, or high-volume consumer digital businesses.
  • Demonstrated ability to build repeatable experimentation, reporting, or AI-enabled workflows that improve team speed and quality.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Design, Analytics, and Engineering.

Measures of Success:

  • Successful connection of digital experience priorities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Improvement in conversion, engagement, subscriber growth, and retention KPIs.
  • Predictable delivery of high-quality experiments and launches.
  • Strong cross-functional alignment and reduced operational friction.
All GoodRx employees are responsible for reviewing and complying with all Company safety and security policies and procedures, being vigilant and observant of potential security threats (including phishing attempts) and proactively communicating with the Security Team to raise any concerns.

The pay ranges below are shown as a guideline, and the successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and other relevant business and organizational factors. $80,000.00 - $128,000.00

GoodRx also offers additional compensation programs such as annual cash bonuses or commission, and annual equity grants for most positions as well as generous benefits. Our great benefits offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with a company match, an ESPP, unlimited vacation, 13 paid holidays, and 72 hours of sick leave. GoodRx also offers additional benefits like mental wellness and financial wellness programs, fertility benefits, generous parental leave, pet insurance, supplemental life insurance for you and your dependents, company-paid short-term and long-term disability, and more!

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company and industry. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of the best and brightest from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has a seat at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunities to excel.

With that said, research shows that women and other underrepresented groups apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria. Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .
IT at Sophos is the powerhouse behind world-class business capabilities, applications, infrastructure, and services that bring our company’s vision and strategy to life. Led by a seasoned leadership team with deep expertise in the security industry, and powered by technical contributors recognized as trailblazers in their fields, our department thrives on innovation and agility to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Joining our team means becoming part of a culture that champions creativity and excellence while investing in your growth. We are dedicated to your professional development, offering exciting opportunities to elevate your skills and advance your career.

Corporate Identity is a critical control point for Sophos, underpinning everything our employees do and serving as a foundation for our certification and compliance programs. We are looking for a Senior Identity Engineer to join our team of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) who manage our modern identity stack, covering everything identity related from Passkeys through to our Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) processes.

  • Contribute, and lead corporate identity projects, from Passkey deployments through to the retirement of legacy technology
  • Act as an SME in one or more of Microsoft Entra ID, Saviynt, MiServer AD

  • Stay up to date with industry trends in PAM, PIM, and IGA
  • Work using agile methodologies
  • Join the identity team out of hours support rota

  • Hands-on experience and SME knowledge with OIDC, SCIM, OAuth, PAM, and PIM solutions
  • Experience managing and SME knowledge with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Microsoft Active Directory
  • Experience with Saviynt
  • Understanding of identity governance and compliance controls
  • Desirable:
  • Terraform experience
  • Azure/Microsoft Certfications

Job Title: Pricing Analyst

A bit about us:

We’re on a mission to change the tire industry — how it’s delivered and how it’s experienced. A pioneer in the automotive e-commerce industry, we take pride in our extensive selection of top-name brands and budget-friendly options, ensuring our customers find the perfect tire to suit their needs. As a part of our growing and dynamic team, you'll contribute to our commitment to exceptional service, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Embrace the opportunity to be a driving force behind one of the fastest growing e-commerce companies in the US and apply now!

A bit more about this role:

The Pricing Analyst will own the strategy, execution, and financial performance of our comprehensive pricing operations across all sales channels. Initially, this role will focus on optimizing pricing strategies across proprietary and third party channels with planned expansion into new B2B customer pricing as the business grows. Sitting at the intersection of market intelligence, finance and business strategy, you will develop and implement pricing strategies to optimize revenue, margin, and market competitiveness. You will operate in an entrepreneurial environment with direct exposure to our company’s executive leadership.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related analytical field
  • 2-4+ years of professional experience in pricing analysis, revenue management, financial analysis, or a related role requiring strong analytical rigor and strategic thinking.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with essential proficiency in data analysis
  • Access to high-speed home Wi-Fi, and be able to work effectively during US business hours

Responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive pricing strategies across all channels, generating creative solutions to optimize price positioning in competitive markets, and staying informed on industry pricing trends and competitor actions
  • Design, implement, meticulously track, and analyze pricing experiments and tests to optimize revenue and margin, documenting learnings and informing scalable pricing strategies based on elasticity analysis and competitive intelligence
  • Support company management with pricing recommendations and financial modeling, representing analytical findings with clear presentations and data visualizations, pursuing pricing optimization opportunities, and managing pricing policy implementations
  • Own key pricing performance metrics (e.g., margin analysis, price realization, competitive positioning, revenue impact), ensure pricing compliance across channels, and proactively work with teams to address pricing discrepancies
  • Analyze large datasets related to sales performance, cost structures, market pricing, customer segments, and price sensitivity to identify trends, generate actionable pricing insights, and develop regular pricing performance reports for stakeholders
  • Coordinate regular competitive pricing audits and market analysis to identify pricing opportunities, gaps, and optimization potential across product categories
  • Perform real-time monitoring of pricing performance and competitive dynamics, addressing pricing issues promptly and recommending immediate adjustments when necessary

Attributes to success:

  • Ability to understand complex models, generate innovative pricing solutions within market constraints, and exhibit strong quantitative problem-solving skills
  • Being highly self-directed, proactive, motivated, organized, and possessing exceptional attention to detail to manage multiple pricing initiatives effectively
  • Showing willingness to deeply investigate pricing strategies, market dynamics, competitor behavior, cost structures, and customer price sensitivity

Desired skills & experience:

  • Familiarity with statistical analysis tools (e.g., R, Python) or advanced Excel modeling, experiences with business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
  • Technical proficiency in Google Suite or Microsoft Office Suite, experience with SQL or similar database query languages.
  • Understanding of pricing strategies in e-commerce or retail environments, experience with A/B testing and statistical significance in pricing experiments
  • Basic knowledge of financial analysis

raw.description:
About Exelab and Polyant

Exelab builds custom, AI-powered solutions around real business needs. We work in small teams and use AI directly in how we design and build software.

You will join the team building Polyant, our open-source, self-hosted runtime for AI agents. It brings together memory, retrieval over business documents, tool and plugin execution, messaging channels, permissions, tracing and cost control, behind an OpenAI-compatible API and an administration interface.

Explore the product before applying:

Documentation:

Code:

The role

Your primary focus will be Polyant: building features, improving reliability and helping shape the product over time. You will work across the platform, from the administration interface and runtime to the database and release pipeline, taking ownership of defined product areas in collaboration with the team.

This role suits an engineer with solid experience shipping and maintaining production software, who can turn an ambiguous need into a scoped proposal, explain architectural trade-offs and follow a change through to release. Ownership includes maintenance, documentation and learning from failures.

Research and experimentation are part of the work. You will test ideas around agent behaviour, retrieval, memory and evaluation, then turn promising results into maintainable product capabilities. The focus is software and agent engineering; model training, fine-tuning and MLOps are outside this role's scope.

What you will do

  • Design and deliver features end to end, from the data model and APIs to the user interface, tests and documentation.

  • Own the technical decisions within your areas and make explicit trade-offs between user value, implementation effort, reliability and maintenance cost.

  • Develop agent capabilities such as tool execution, context management, retrieval and memory, with clear handling of failure modes.

  • Protect a multi-tenant platform through sound authorization, data isolation, input validation and careful review.

  • Build regression tests and agent evaluations; use traces, latency and cost measurements to assess changes.

  • Keep releases dependable through CI/CD, safe database migrations, deployment practices and investigation of production issues.

  • Use AI coding agents deliberately: provide context and constraints, split work into reviewable changes, and verify generated code against the intended behaviour.

  • Propose product improvements and share experiments, decisions and findings with the team.

Requirements

Essential experience and skills

  • A track record of delivering production software and maintaining it over time, with examples of decisions and outcomes you can explain.

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills, plus practical React experience and the ability to work across backend and frontend.

  • Experience with relational databases, API design, authentication and authorization.

  • Sound software design, debugging and refactoring skills, supported by automated tests and code review.

  • Practical experience with LLM APIs and agent workflows, including tool calling, structured output, context limits and the impact of cost and latency.

  • An evidence-based approach to reliability: you can explain how you test uncertain behaviour and investigate failures.

  • Practical use of AI coding tools, with the ability to critically review their output.

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD and deploying software; willingness to take responsibility for its behaviour after release.

  • Clear written communication, fluent professional Italian and working English. Based in Italy.

Useful additional experience

  • Next.js, NestJS, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Docker or AWS CDK. These are parts of our stack; prior mastery of every tool is not required.

  • Retrieval systems, embeddings, hybrid search, chunking or reranking.

  • Agent evaluation, tracing, context compaction, lifecycle hooks, guardrails or MCP.

  • Multi-tenant or self-hosted products, open-source contributions or developer-facing tools.

How we work and what you can expect

  • A small team where your work contributes directly to a visible product and its technical direction.

  • Technical collaboration, regular feedback and knowledge sharing as you build deeper expertise in agent systems.

  • Room for focused experimentation, with a clear path from a hypothesis to a measured result and a product decision.

  • A remote working environment in Italy, with ownership scoped to clear priorities and outcomes.

Salary range: 40-50 K

About the Role

Our client is seeking a highly organized, visually talented Design Intern or Junior Interior Design & Procurement Assistant to support our hospitality, commercial, and residential interior design projects.

This person will work closely with our design team across both the creative and administrative sides of a project. We are looking for someone who is technically capable, exceptionally organized, comfortable working independently, and has a strong eye for elevated, thoughtful interior design.

3D rendering experience and an efficient, easy-to-use rendering workflow are essential. The ideal candidate can take architectural drawings, inspiration, specifications, and design direction and efficiently translate them into compelling 3D visuals without requiring extensive oversight.

The position will also provide critical support with FF&E sourcing, specifications, procurement tracking, vendor management, and project documentation.

Key Responsibilities

3D Rendering & Design Support

· Create high-quality interior 3D renderings efficiently and accurately.

· Translate design direction, floor plans, elevations, inspiration imagery, and specifications into visual presentations.

· Produce renderings appropriate for residential, hospitality, and commercial environments.

· Make revisions to renderings quickly as designs evolve.

· Read and understand architectural and CAD drawings.

· Assist with space planning and design documentation.

· Sketchup and/or Revit drafting experience is highly desirable.

FF&E Research & Specifications

· Research furniture, fixtures, equipment, lighting, plumbing, hardware, materials, accessories, artwork, and other FF&E based on direction from the lead designer.

· Identify products that meet project aesthetic, dimensions, performance requirements, budget, lead time, and intended use.

· Understand that specifications may differ substantially between residential, hospitality, and commercial applications.

· Research alternate products when selections are unavailable, outside budget, or do not meet project requirements.

· Maintain accurate product information, including dimensions, finishes, pricing, lead times, vendor information, links, and relevant technical specifications.

Specification Books

· Create and maintain comprehensive project specification books.

· Ensure each selection contains all relevant information needed for purchasing, installation, construction coordination, and client approval.

· Maintain accurate and current product details as selections change.

· Organize specifications so information can be easily accessed by designers, architects, contractors, installers, purchasing teams, and other project partners.

· Maintain consistency and accuracy across drawings, specifications, schedules, and procurement documentation.

Procurement Tracking

· Maintain detailed procurement trackers from specification through final delivery and installation.

· Track quotes, approvals, purchase orders, deposits/payments, production status, estimated ship dates, shipping, receiving, damages, backorders, replacements, and installation status.

· Follow up proactively on outstanding quotes, orders, samples, and lead times.

· Flag delays, discrepancies, or missing information before they become project problems.

· Maintain exceptionally accurate project records.

Vendor & Trade Account Management

· Research and establish new vendor, manufacturer, and trade accounts.

· Complete account applications and organize required documentation.

· Maintain vendor contacts, account information, discount structures, ordering requirements, minimums, and trade program information.

· Communicate professionally with vendor representatives regarding pricing, availability, samples, specifications, lead times, and order information.

Required Skills

· Strong 3D interior rendering skills and demonstrated rendering portfolio.

  • Licensed Interior Designer

· Ability to produce renderings efficiently and make revisions without a cumbersome workflow.

· Ability to read and interpret architectural and CAD drawings.

· Strong understanding of interior design, scale, proportion, materials, finishes, and spatial relationships.

· Excellent internet and product research abilities.

· Exceptional attention to detail.

· Strong organizational and documentation skills.

· Comfortable working with spreadsheets, project trackers, shared drives, and cloud-based systems.

· Strong written English and professional vendor communication.

· Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently.

· Comfortable receiving design direction and translating it into completed work without requiring constant supervision.

Preferred Skills

· Revit experience.

· SketchUp and/or other professional interior rendering software.

· Previous experience with an interior design or architecture firm.

· FF&E specification and procurement experience.

· Hospitality and/or commercial design experience is particularly valuable.

· Familiarity with the U.S. interior design, furnishings, fixtures, and materials markets.

· Experience working with U.S.-based vendors, manufacturers, and trade accounts.

Ideal Candidate

The right person is both creative and highly organized.

We are looking for someone who understands that excellent interior design depends not only on beautiful ideas, but also on accurate documentation and excellent execution.

You should be comfortable moving between a creative assignment such as producing a beautiful rendering and a highly detailed assignment such as verifying dimensions, updating a specification book, researching an alternate fixture, organizing vendor information, or tracking an order.

Because our client works across hospitality, commercial, and residential environments, we value someone who is curious and adaptable rather than limited to a single project type.

You are proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable asking thoughtful questions when necessary—but your natural instinct is to research, problem-solve, and move the work forward.

Requirements

This is a full time job

Up to $8/hr

100% Remote

raw.excerpt: If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you!
raw.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a unique role within Contract Underwriting that is responsible for leveraging strong partner relationships, a solution-oriented mindset, and technical underwriting acumen to drive profitable growth across the Alternative Distribution portfolio.

In this role, you will partner with Contract Underwriting appointed Wholesale Managing General Agents to vet, operationalize, manage, and grow new and existing alternatively distributed products. Alternative Distribution refers to business that is solicited through wholesale binding distribution and generally falls within Contract Underwriting appetite but is transacted via non-traditional channels, i.e. digital storefronts and non-API supported placement (i.e. bordereaux).

You’ll be responsible for vetting, developing, and actively managing these solutions and collaborating with partners to analyze, develop, implement, and refine underwriting guidelines and pricing as appropriate. You will manage the P&L of each individual solution and handle individual account underwriting for referral business that falls outside prescribed authority. You will also provide operational support and oversight to ensure non-API supported solutions such as bordereaux-managed business is captured and ingested appropriately as well as ensuring the risks within the greater portfolio fall within prescribed authority, mix of business targets, and other predefined underwriting parameters. In order to be successful in this role, you will need to build and maintain effective relationships with internal business liaisons as well as external partners.

Additional expectations associated with this role:

Portfolio & Profitability Management:

  • Monitor program and portfolio performance, including profitability, growth, and loss trends; develop and implement corrective action plans as needed.

  • Analyze results across programs, classes of business, and geographies to optimize underwriting strategy.

  • Participate in and support bi-annual underwriting audits as needed to ensure guideline adherence; provide detailed analysis and recommendations based on findings.

  • Produce and deliver monthly and ad hoc performance reports to underwriting leadership and other internal/external stakeholders.

Product Development & Strategy:

  • Conduct research, development, and implementation of new and existing solutions, including underwriting guidelines, forms and rate structures.

  • Collaborate with external partners as well as internal business liaisons to design and deploy product-specific tools and enhancements.

  • Recommend and implement updates to underwriting guidelines based on product performance, market trends and emerging risks.

  • Identify and capitalize on new business opportunities through market analysis and strategic insight.

Relationship Management & Business Development:

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with wholesale managing general agents and internal stakeholders to drive profitable growth.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and technical underwriting resource to partners, resolving complex issues and supporting deal execution.

  • Conduct regular communication with partners to assess market conditions, profitability, and pipeline opportunities.

  • Travel as needed for agency visits, audits, marketing meetings, and relationship-building activities.

  • Represent the organization at industry events and contribute to marketing initiatives that promote underwriting capabilities and generate new business opportunities.

Ideal Candidate Will Possess:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Risk Management, or related field preferred.

  • Approximately 6+ years of experience in specialty, program, or contract underwriting.

  • Strong understanding of underwriting guidelines, insurance law, contract structures, and coverage design.

  • Knowledge of reinsurance principles and placement strategies preferred.

*This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program*

Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As an Underwriting Specialist in Contract you determine individual risk acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of a complex technical nature for the assigned line of business. In addition, you’ll achieve production and loss ratio goals with assigned general agents or program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. General agent assignments are more complex in terms of coverage and general agent relationships. It’s important to establish and maintain effective relationships with general agents to generate premium dollars and profitability. You will work independently with a high level of authority and judgment. Determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual accounts is an important element of this role. We will count on you to foster positive business relationships with co-workers, general agents and reinsurers. You will also assist with research, development and presentation of new products, forms and manuals and have opportunities to assist in the training and mentoring of Underwriters and Underwriting Assistants.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned agents or programs within assigned territory and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. The underwriter analyzes, with a high level of technical expertise, exposures to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure and determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract. Within department guidelines, places reinsurance, if any, for the account.

  • Achieves individual production and loss ratio goals within assigned territory through sound territory management and marketing. Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis. Works with more complex issues concerning coverage, programs, agents and program managers. The underwriter continually analyzes premium and loss results in their territory or assigned agents by agency, state, major class of business and by program. Continually assess quality of submissions and makes corrective action recommendations. Development and implementation of specific action plans may be required

  • Handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and processes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews loss control reports and makes recommendations to the agent and/or changes to the policy. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with general agents through daily contact with assigned agents by developing and maintaining good rapport and resolving agency conflicts. Travels to agency offices as required for audits, training or marketing visits. Entertains agents visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for underwriting seminars and other marketing campaigns.

  • Places reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with reinsurers.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

Since 2017, HTX Labs has been on a mission to accelerate the future of learning, employing immersive software training solutions and content development services for the Department of Defense to elevate the level of proficiency and preparedness of today's warfighter.

HTX Labs developed the EMPACT® Immersive Learning Platform to address a growing need to modernize training, improve safety, maximize operational efficiency, and build resilience and readiness across the defense industry.

HTX Labs is dedicated to driving learning innovation, providing the necessary digital infrastructure to empower users to easily create, deploy, measure, and sustain mission-specific, immersive training programs anytime, anywhere, on any device, with anyone, at scale.

As we continue to grow, we're always looking to connect with exceptional people who are passionate about technology, innovation, and making an impact.

Who We're Looking For

We welcome interest from talented professionals across a variety of disciplines, including:

  • Software Engineering
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • XR Development
  • Product Management
  • UX/UI Design
  • DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure
  • Cybersecurity
  • Data and Analytics
  • Instructional Design

The people who thrive at HTX Labs tend to be:

  • Curious and eager to learn
  • Comfortable solving complex problems
  • Willing to take ownership and drive outcomes
  • Collaborative and respectful teammates
  • Focused on delivering value to customers
  • Adaptable in a fast-moving environment

We are particularly interested in people who thoughtfully incorporate AI into their work. Whether you're building software, creating content, designing experiences, analyzing data, or improving business operations, we value individuals who use modern tools to work smarter, move faster, and achieve better outcomes. Technology changes quickly. We look for people who embrace continuous learning and are excited to explore new ways of working.

Meaningful work with real-world impact

Opportunity to help shape the future of immersive learning

Collaborative, high-trust culture

Remote-first environment

Talented teammates who care deeply about what they build

A company committed to innovation, growth, and continuous improvement

Submit your resume along with a brief introduction telling us:

Applicants must reside in the United States, be a U.S. citizen or Permanent Resident, be authorized to work in the U.S. and be able to prove these facts.

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents by finding publicly accessible Gujarati PDFs with multimodal elements like images, tables, or handwriting.

Must-Have

  • Native Gujarati speaker with full command of the script.
  • Experience in annotation, transcription, translation, or regional-language data review.
  • High character-level accuracy.
  • Systematic approach to applying taxonomy across pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like multi-column newspapers and handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Experience with regional-language AI data annotation, labeling, or bilingual evaluation.
  • Skills in transcription and localization, such as MTPE, subtitling, or OCR correction.
  • Document production experience in typesetting, copy-editing, or proofreading Gujarati-language material.
  • Knowledge of script and encoding, including Unicode normalization.

About This Role

Hi, we’re so excited that you’re here and interested in a career at Compass! If you want some help finding the right path for you, you’re in the right place.

Between our 3 locations across the Chicagoland area, ever-growing virtual program, newest East Coast facility in Maryland, and our upcoming sites in Minnesota and Wisconsin, we have plenty of opportunities for a wide variety of clinical backgrounds and interests.

Maybe you’re looking for a role that’s not currently open, or just aren’t sure which program to apply to. Either way, we’d love to add you to our network of talented and passionate clinicians.

  • BE or BC in the state you are applying
  • Licensed or ability to obtain Illinois Board of Medical Practice Licensure.
  • Ability to obtain and/or maintain DEA certification for the State you are applying.
  • Skilled in the evaluation and treatment of mental illness.
  • Excellent communication skills and the desire to work in a collaborative, team-based environment.

We know job descriptions can be intimidating, so if this sounds like an opportunity for you, please don't hesitate to apply!

Who We Are

Compass Health Center is a recognized leader in crisis-level mental health, bringing passion, connection, and patient-centered care to the Partial Hospitalization and Intensive Outpatient space (PHP/IOP). Based in Chicagoland, we serve hundreds of patients every day, ranging from ages 5 through adulthood, in our onsite facilities or through our flourishing virtual programming. Compass fills a critical gap between outpatient and inpatient care through an intermediate level of Behavioral Healthcare.

A few more things we want you to know: our values are super important to us, and hopefully will be to you, too. Cultural humility, teamwork, continuous improvement, connection, patient centered care, passion, innovation, and agility should be your power sources. Joining Compass is an opportunity to feel fulfilled through a joint mission towards healing our communities.

What’s Next?

Compass is committed to cultivating diverse and dynamic teams who exude passion for their craft, so whether or not you check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply – we’d be grateful to hear from you!

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



​About the Role:

The CrowdStrike Intelligence team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on our dedicated engineering team, building processing pipelines, information storage systems and presentation layers in support of our world-class team of analysts and researchers.

The collection, processing, and exploration of information at a large scale is at the core of the Intelligence mission at CrowdStrike. The Intelligence Automation team is responsible for prototyping, building and operating the systems that make up our Intelligence pipeline, and we'd like you to join us!

You will use your deep experience in scalable, distributed architectures to design flexible data integration and processing systems in a fast-paced Intelligence environment. In this environment, requirements sometimes shift rapidly, and projects can live anything from weeks to years depending on changes in the surrounding ecosystem. You will be responsible for all aspects of the software you design, from initial design, over hands-on prototyping, overseeing and taking an active part in the actual implementation, down to deployment to production, and ensuring smooth operations. In addition, you will be responsible for proper documentation and training of customers of the systems you design. You will interact regularly with your internal customers to gather requirements, solicit feedback, and validate your results. We are agnostic when it comes to technology stacks, and you will be free to pick the technologies and tools that best fit the purpose at any given time, based on your previous exposure to a wide variety of technologies such as programming languages, database systems, network protocols, queuing and messaging systems, etc.

As a remote employee on a team distributed across various time zones, you will not have direct access to all of your co-workers at every point of time, so your ability to work unsupervised, communicate asynchronously, and take the initiative in maintaining lines of communication is crucial. In addition, we are looking for someone who would like to be part of a team who are passionate about their work and go the extra mile to exceed expectations. We love enthusiastic individuals who bring a positive attitude to their work and really care about what they produce for our internal customers.

What You’ll Do:

  • Integrate into the Intelligence team and gather requirements from Intelligence Analysts and Technical Analysts as internal customers

  • Assume responsibility for the long-term maintenance of both, new and legacy systems

  • Autonomously develop requirements based on anything from vague mission statements to very detailed technical specifications

  • Experience in developing scalable, distributed and production-grade services

  • Proficiency in Linux and containers

  • Proficiency in hands-on coding in multiple programming languages

  • Knowledge of SQL and No-SQL database systems

  • Knowledge of cloud technologies

  • Ability to maintain and improve existing Go and Python code bases

  • Ability to communicate technical detail in a simple, top-down manner to management, customers, and peers

  • Ability to independentlymake sound, justifiable decisions and take action

  • Ability to plan, organize and prioritize work independently and meet deadlines

  • Ability to work on a geographically distributed and diverse team

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with the AWS or GCP cloud ecosystem (e.g. EC2, S3, VPC, ECS)

  • Experience developing Web UIs, e.g. Single-Page-Applications (SPA)

  • Experience creating scalable and well-documented HTTP APIs

  • Experience with malware analysis or software reverse engineering

  • Offensive information security experience, e.g. from capture-the-flag (CTF) competitions

Experience with HVAC systems and sheet metal is a plus. The candidate must be well versed in Solidworks as it relates to creating piping assemblies and documents to fabricate these assemblies.

Our primary focus is on providing an integrated cooling system for data centers and commercial buildings that dramatically reduces the energy demand, water consumption and cost of cooling. It transforms the economics and eco-metrics of commercial cooling with zero water solutions that outperform air- and water-cooled systems in any climate.

A flexible, autonomous work environment.

A culture of respect, learning, and excellence.
Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers.

raw.excerpt: A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr• Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
raw.description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

  • Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
  • We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

  • Meaningful connections start with AUTHENTICITY
  • We do our best work by being CURIOUS
  • We grow by remaining DYNAMIC
  • Our success combines AMBITIOUS VISION with OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE
  • At the heart of great partnerships we’ll always find EMPATHY

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

The Senior Content Specialist is the experienced professional responsible for reviewing flagged and reported content, making final enforcement decisions within an established policy framework, and owning the customer conversation when those decisions are appealed. Automated systems catch a large share of policy violations, but this role exists to catch what the system gets wrong, and to hold the line where it's right. This is a journey-level Trust & Safety position requiring independent judgment, sound written communication, and comfort operating with real autonomy on complex, sensitive cases.

WHY DO WE WANT YOU

We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

  • Work the content moderation queue: review flagged content against the actual material rather than relying solely on automated summaries, verify claims, and factor in the distinct weight of automated flags vs. multiple human reports
  • Decide and act at the appropriate scope, from removing a single item to disabling a full account or workspace, using the standard reason taxonomy and maintaining a clear audit trail for every decision
  • Own the customer conversation end to end: take handoffs from front-line support, evaluate appeals against what's actually on record, and write responses yourself, including denials and final-decision notices that cite the specific policy section, without disclosing investigative detail
  • Process refunds or related account actions where policy windows apply
  • Maintain a full decision log with supporting reasoning, and mark confirmed false positives so recurring issues stop re-flagging
  • Triage sensitive and high-severity content categories using organizational guidelines, escalating genuinely ambiguous cases and immediately escalating anything meeting the threshold for mandatory reporting
  • Recognize coordinated abuse patterns across multiple accounts, distinguishing genuine bad-actor networks from legitimate accounts affected by report-bombing
  • Handle data export and account recovery requests, denying them cleanly when policy requires
  • Diagnose non-abuse issues that surface in the queue (system false positives, technical breakage) and route them to the right team with supporting detail already gathered
  • Improve the system, not just the queue: refine customer-facing response templates, surface false-positive patterns, and flag policy gaps to your manager
  • Exposure to disturbing material is part of the job, including content flagged for explicit, graphic, hateful, or exploitative content
  • The most difficult content is often the content that gets appealed; you may review the same case more than once, weighing a customer's argument against the original decision
  • Sustainable pacing and support matter: this role requires the ability to flag when a case is affecting you and a manager who treats that as normal
  • Decisions are asymmetric in consequence: an incorrect removal costs a legitimate customer their work, while an incorrect restoration can put real harm back on a live platform
  • Some content and context will be intentionally restricted from your view, requiring patience and a habit of escalating in batches

Requirements

WHAT WE’LL LIKE ABOUT YOU

YOU ARE…

  • Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
  • An analytical and critical thinker, comfortable making high-stakes judgment calls independently
  • Calm under pressure, including with hostile or upset customers
  • Investigative by instinct: you notice when something doesn't add up

YOU HAVE…

  • Formal grounding in content moderation, trust & safety, or a related compliance/enforcement discipline, through certification, a structured training program, or documented equivalent hands-on experience
  • 3 to 4+ years of related work experience with general knowledge within a trust & safety, compliance, or risk-adjacent functional area
  • Demonstrated ability to make and defend enforcement decisions independently, while knowing precisely which cases require escalation
  • Willingness to reverse a prior decision in writing when new information changes the picture, without ego about the original call
  • Strong written English: your responses reach customers unedited
  • Comfort with case-management and reporting tools (e.g., ticketing systems, internal admin tools, spreadsheets)

At Martin, our goal is to build strong, lasting relationships with partners who share our values, vision, and commitment to mutual success.

The Opportunity

Martin is a trusted partner to insurance carriers and MGAs across the United States, supporting their most critical initiatives — regulatory compliance, state filings, product development, technology, due diligence, and operational efficiency. As the firm evolves its model to pair deep consulting expertise with proprietary software solutions, we are adding a Sales Engineer to own the technical win across every deal on our platform.

The Sales Engineer is the technical counterpart to our sales team and the bridge between what a client needs and what Martin can actually build, configure, and deliver. You'll lead technical discovery, run demonstrations, design the solution, and prove it out — through proofs of concept, integration discussions, security questionnaires, and RFP responses — so that what we propose is technically sound and genuinely solvable. Because our platform is sold with delivery attached, your solution design shapes both the software configuration and the services wrapped around it, and the scope you validate is the scope our teams commit to.

We're looking for someone who can hold their own with a client's CIO and their compliance officer in the same meeting — someone who understands the insurance business deeply enough to diagnose the real problem and knows the technology well enough to prove the answer works. If you've built your career in or around insurance technology and want to own the technical win on deals that matter, this role was designed for you.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery support: Partner with sales to run technical discovery, surface the requirements and constraints that determine feasibility, and ensure the right questions get asked before a solution is shaped.

Technical demonstrations: Deliver tailored demonstrations that connect platform capability to the client's specific operating reality, not a generic feature tour.

Solution design: Architect the platform configuration and services approach that solves the client's problem and validate that it can be delivered as designed.

Proofs of concept: Scope, build, and run POCs that de-risk the decision for the client and the commitment for Martin.

Security questionnaires: Own technical responses to security, privacy, and vendor-risk reviews.

Integration discussions: Lead conversations on data, systems, and integration with client technical stakeholders and their vendors.

RFP technical responses: Author and own the technical sections of RFP and RFI responses.

Technical validation: Confirm that what we propose is achievable within the stated scope, assumptions, and timeline before it is committed.

Handoff to implementation: Transition each won deal to the implementation team with the context, requirements, and documented solution design they need to start clean.

Who You Are

You’ve spent your career in or close to the insurance industry. You understand how carriers think, how products are built and filed, and what keeps a Product Manager, Chief Actuary or compliance leader up at night. You’re someone who gets energized by solving hard problems with clients, and whose instinct is to listen and diagnose before proposing solutions. You bring a practitioner’s credibility to every conversation that results in key sales and long-term partnerships with clients.

Insurance fluent. You've built your career in or around carriers and MGAs, and you understand how the business actually runs — policy administration, underwriting, product development, filings, and the regulatory pressure shaping all of it. Nobody needs to explain the acronyms to you.

Technically credible. You can hold a substantive conversation about data models, APIs, integration patterns, and system architecture with a client's technical team, and you know where the real constraints live. You aren't expected to write production code; you are expected to be believed by the people who do.

A strong demonstrator. You build demos around the client's problem rather than the product feature list, and you can improvise when a prospect takes the conversation somewhere you didn't plan for.

Disciplined about scope. You would rather surface a hard constraint before a contract is signed than discover it in implementation. You are comfortable telling a prospect — and your own sales team — when something won't work the way it's being imagined.

A clear writer. RFP responses, security questionnaires, and solution documentation are a real part of this job, and your work stands up to a technical reviewer without needing to be rewritten.

Credible in both rooms. You can move between a CFO's business case and an IT director's integration questions in the same meeting, adjusting altitude without losing either of them.

Comfortable building. Martin is evolving from a consulting firm into a firm that sells consulting and software together. Some of the process around this role is still being written, and you see that as something to shape rather than something to wait out.

Why Join Us?

Martin offers a unique platform: the credibility and depth of a specialized insurance consulting firm, combined with a growing suite of proprietary technology solutions. You’ll have the backing of a deeply experienced team, a strong existing client base, and a genuine opportunity to shape how the firm grows with its most important clients.

Growth-Oriented Culture: Work with a leadership team committed to innovation and revenue expansion.

Competitive Earning Potential: Base salary plus bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package that rewards expertise and contributions.

Legacy of Excellence: Be part of a well-respected organization with over 30 years of leadership in the insurance industry.

Dynamic Team Culture: Work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate, driven, and committed to success.

Salary and Benefits

The OTE for this position is $160-$200K + (70/30 Base/Variable). Final salary offer will be based on several factors, including commensurate experience, qualifications, and skills. Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance. These benefits include:

Health, dental, and vision insurance

401(k) retirement plan options

Generous, flexible paid-time-off (PTO) policy

AL, AZ, CO, FL, GA, ID, IN, LA, MD, MS, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA

Summary: The Business Systems Analyst collaborates with the Product Owner, Scrum Master, and other Agile Team members to translate software requirements into clear, actionable user stories and deliverables for the delivery team. The Business Systems Analyst serves as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, supporting effective execution across the Development Life Cycle. This role operates within a SAFe Agile environment and is accountable for ensuring requirements are clearly understood, well-defined, and ready to support successful delivery.

Key Responsibilities: “To simplify complexities for each customer.”

The Business Systems Analyst demonstrates reliable proficiency and autonomy, applying skills effectively in most scenarios while requiring minimal supervision and guidance.

Requirements Elicitation, Documentation & Process Mapping

    • Work closely with business and technical stakeholders to gather, identify, and define detailed business and technical requirements. Create clear, concise, and well-structured documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, and user stories that describe system features and functionality from the end-user perspective. Analyze and document current and future-state business processes and workflows to support a shared understanding of requirements and solution scope. Ensure requirements and process documentation align with business goals, objectives, and agreed-upon solution scope.

Requirements Research & Analysis

    • Conduct research and analysis to determine what the system must do to fulfill requirements across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), spanning all requirement types, including business, functional, non-functional, and transitional requirements. Clarify and refine requirements with stakeholders to resolve ambiguities, manage expectations, and maintain clear communication across teams. Analysis may include modeling, journey mapping, story mapping, and, when appropriate, limited code or API review using tools such as Swagger.

Adherence to BSA Standards & Contribution to Knowledge Sharing

    • Adhere to established BSA standards, processes, and documentation guidelines. Actively participate in BSA Communities of Practice and assist in the identification, documentation, communication, and maintenance of business analysis practices to ensure alignment with Agile methodology, organizational objectives, and BSA community goals. Create and maintain informational documentation to support knowledge sharing within the BSA team and Agile Teams.

Adherence to Agile and SAFe Practices

    • Operate within a SAFe Agile environment by following established Agile principles, practices, and ceremonies. Apply Agile documentation principles and support consistent, high-quality execution across iterations.

Backlog Management & Agile Execution Support

    • Refining and maintaining the product backlog using agreed-upon tools such as Jira. Responsibilities include identifying and documenting user stories, defining and refining shell stories, splitting stories appropriately, analyzing and documenting stories using modeling techniques, performing story mapping, and ensuring stories are properly tied to epics. Actively participate in backlog refinement sessions and Agile ceremonies, confirming stories meet the Definition of Ready, align with team goals and delivery timelines, and support maintaining at least two iterations of ready work in accordance with SAFe standards.

Facilitation & Collaboration

    • Facilitate and actively participate in meetings to ensure prioritized objectives are clearly defined and supported for timely execution. Lead or co-facilitate refinement sessions and contribute meaningfully to Agile ceremonies. Serve as a bridge between business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders by helping manage differing viewpoints constructively, promoting collaboration, alignment with goals, and a positive working environment. When needed, provide short-term support by backfilling Agile roles such as Product Owner or Scrum Master, with appropriate guidance.

Testing, Validation & Implementation Support

    • Provide ongoing support to delivery teams during testing and implementation. Responsibilities include answering user-story-related questions, collaborating with Product Owners and stakeholders to clarify requirements, reviewing technical designs for alignment with requirements and underlying needs, coordinating user acceptance testing, developing test plans, validating system changes, assisting with script writing, and supporting day-to-day production issues as needed.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

    • Identify and engage with key business and technical stakeholders to ensure their needs, concerns, and feedback are understood and incorporated into system and process requirements. Collaborate across teams and departments to support successful solution delivery. Serves as the bridge between business users, IT teams, and other stakeholders, all of whom might have differing viewpoints, requirements, or expectations.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

    • Actively pursue opportunities to develop business analysis, technical, and domain knowledge. Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving methodologies. Contribute ideas and creative solutions to improve processes, systems, or services, supporting a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability. Thinks outside the box, solve problems in unique ways, and drives improvements that will make a difference in our organization.

Qualifications/Education/Certifications:

Bachelor's degree from four-year College or university; plus, three to six years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Required:

  • Must have hands-on experience with Appian
  • An understanding of SQL (Depends on assignment)
  • Sense of urgency: The ability to respond quickly and effectively to tasks, deadlines, and challenges, often within a fast-paced or high-pressure environment ensuring that goals and objectives are met in a timely manner without compromising quality.
  • Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving: The ability to identify patterns, analyze complex data, and develop solutions to problems in business processes or systems.
  • Communication Skills: Effective communication (written, verbal, and non-verbal) to facilitate understanding and collaboration among stakeholders, team members, and management.
  • Interaction Skills: The ability to facilitate meetings, work collaboratively with different stakeholders, manage conflicts, and build consensus.
  • Stakeholder Analysis: Understanding the needs, expectations, and influences of stakeholders, and the ability to engage them in the business analysis process.
  • Modeling Skills: The ability to create and use various models, diagrams, and visualizations to represent business processes, workflows, or system designs.
  • Documentation and Specification: The ability to document requirements, processes, and other key artifacts clearly and in a structured way.
  • Adaptability: The ability to adjust to changing conditions, requirements, and unexpected challenges.
  • Conflict Resolution: The ability to recognize, address, and resolve conflicts that may arise during the business analysis process or with stakeholders.

Preferred:

  • Experience in Healthcare, Pharmacy Benefits Management and/or Ancillary Benefits Management, workers’ compensation and/or insurance industry
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.
  • Certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), SAFe® (Scaled Agile Framework) certifications, or Appian Certifications.
  • Experience with the following:
  • Java
  • Mongo
  • Kafka
  • DataDog
  • Splunk
  • ActiveBatch
  • SOAP webservice
  • REST API
  • MS SQL Server
  • Jira / Confluence
  • GIT
  • SwaggerHub
  • Appian
  • MS Office / Power Platform

Role-Based Competencies: 

  • Shows Drive & Initiative 
  • Collaboration & Teamwork 
  • Delivers Quality Results Timely 
  • Communicates Effectively 
  • Job Knowledge & Skills 

Physical Demands/Working Conditions:

Duties are performed primarily in a home office setting utilizing computer equipment. Travel to attend meetings and visit locations throughout the country may be required. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to use hands. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. *** Job descriptions will be reviewed and are subject to changes of business necessity. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographical cost of labor, etc. In addition to base pay, Healthesystems offers a comprehensive benefits package including, health, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, wellness resources, recognition programs, 401k contribution, and PTO & Holiday pay (all subject to eligibility requirements). Applicable statutory benefits also provided, including the Colorado HFWA.

$68,800—$94,600 USD

raw.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re seeking a Principal Software Engineer to contribute to the technical architecture, design and development of Fivetran’s Managed Data Lake product offering. As part of a senior engineering team, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams to build scalable, high-performance systems, advance open-source technologies, and set technical standards that raise the bar across the organization.

This is a full-time remote position based out of Germany.

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Java, C++, Postgres, Temporal, gRPC
  • AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Grafana
  • Iceberg, Polaris, Delta Lake, Parquet, DuckDB

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with product teams to understand requirements and design cutting-edge new capabilities that go directly into customer’s hands.
  • Design, develop, implement, and operate highly reliable large-scale data lake systems in cooperation with a dedicated data lake engineering team.
  • Contribute to open-source projects such as DuckDB and Polaris.
  • Embrace Fivetran innovations with open-source standards and toolsets.
  • Analyze fault-tolerance and high availability issues, performance and scale challenges, and solve them.
  • Ensure operational excellence of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding security, reliability, availability, and performance.
  • Set technical directions and influence cross-functional teams.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of hands-on or research experience with high-performance relational data management systems.
  • Deep understanding of infrastructure & software optimizations and performance engineering to drive significant performance, latency, and availability improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading and delivering large and complicated projects.
  • Strong development skills in Java and C++.
  • Solid experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Demonstrated knowledge of columnar storage formats.
  • Growth mindset and excitement about breaking the status quo by seeking innovative solutions.
  • Excellent team player who is consistent in making everyone around you better.

Bonus Skills

  • Strongly prefer an MS or PhD in Computer Science, ideally focusing on database management and/or storage engines.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.
