raw.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Sprint With Sprinters

At Sprinto, your work has purpose — and your life has space. We are a workplace where you’re empowered to execute on your most ambitious ideas and deliver your best output in a fast-paced, innovative, and supportive environment.
Joining Sprinto means you will never run alone; you will always have the freedom to take your shot and the support to go farther than you imagined.

What The Role Involves:
At Sprinto, partnerships are the backbone of our revenue strategy. As the Director of Strategic Alliances & Channel Partnerships, you will play a critical role in developing, managing, and scaling strategic relationships with key identified partners . Your primary objective? Fuel Sprinto’s growth by owning and driving 25% of the company's revenue. You’ll have the opportunity to build a high-performing ecosystem of partners and help Sprinto achieve success on a global scale.

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Build Sprinto's partner-led growth engine - Design the strategy, commercial models, and operating rhythm that transform partnerships into a predictable and meaningful revenue channel for the business.
  • Create partnerships that compound - Identify, recruit, and grow relationships across MSPs, MSSPs, GSIs, consulting firms, and strategic technology partners—building an ecosystem that expands Sprinto's reach far beyond direct sales.
  • Turn partnerships into revenue - Design joint go-to-market plans, co-selling motions, and commercial programs that consistently generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across global markets.
  • Build relationships that shape industries - Become a trusted advisor to founders, partner executives, and business leaders, creating long-term relationships that extend beyond individual opportunities.
  • Build the team behind the ecosystem - Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing partnerships team while creating the processes, operating cadence, and culture that enable them to succeed.
  • Shape how Sprinto grows - Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Leadership to ensure every strategic alliance creates value for customers, partners, and Sprinto alike.
  • Create a channel that outlives you - Everything from partner segmentation and governance to enablement and business reviews will become the foundation Sprinto scales for years to come.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

    You'll likely thrive in this role if...
  • You've spent 8–12 years building strategic partnerships, alliances, or commercial businesses, and are excited by the opportunity to create a global revenue engine rather than simply manage existing relationships.
  • You've built partnerships that generated measurable commercial outcomes—not just signed agreements. You think in pipeline, revenue, and long-term business value.
  • You naturally earn the trust of founders, CXOs, and partner executives because you understand how to create outcomes where every stakeholder wins.
  • You've built partner programs before—designing commercial models, joint go-to-market strategies, enablement, and governance that scaled with the business.
  • You enjoy building teams as much as building partnerships. Hiring, coaching, and creating repeatable operating systems are all part of how you think about leadership.
  • You think strategically but execute relentlessly. Whether it's negotiating a complex alliance, reviewing partner performance, or solving cross-functional challenges, you're comfortable moving between vision and execution.
  • You're curious about technology and understand how integrations, APIs, and ecosystem partnerships can become meaningful competitive advantages—not just technical projects.
  • Greenfield opportunities energise you. You enjoy creating structure where none exists and building businesses that leave a lasting impact.
    • If you're looking for a role where you'll inherit a mature partner organisation with established playbooks and predictable revenue, this probably isn't it. But if you're excited to build Sprinto's partnerships business into one of the company's largest growth engines, we'd love to meet you.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

raw.description:
About the company

In the coming decades, our world needs far more critical minerals including copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. The mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold is the leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the position

In this role, you will lead evaluations of potential properties for acquisition, generate targets, and design and oversee field programs from target definition through to resource expansion. You will be part of a multidisciplinary team and will work closely with data scientists, using KoBold’s technology to help guide our field programs and decision-making. You will also work directly with our senior technical advisors and with the executive team on making the investment case for acquisitions and field programs.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by identifying opportunities with rigorous evaluation and by ensuring that we safely and effectively conduct our field programs.

Responsibilities
  • Demonstrate in all activities a commitment to the highest standards in health and safety, environment, and community relations
  • Rigorously analyze geoscientific datasets across a range of scales from provinces to prospects to determine exploration potential and to identify, rank, and prioritize exploration targets
  • Design, budget, permit, and execute field programs ranging from geological mapping and sampling of grass roots prospects through to large drilling programs on advanced projects, with leading industry practice in data acquisition and validation
  • Provide technical guidance and support to local in-country project teams during the design and execution of exploration programs, including site visits and engagement with other project stakeholders (e.g., community representatives, regulatory authorities, and joint venture partners)
  • Work collaboratively with data scientist colleagues to conceive and implement insightful analytical methods
Qualifications

A great Senior Exploration Geologist candidate will have:

  • Strong technical knowledge of one or more ore deposit types. Experience working on sediment-hosted stratiform copper or magmatic sulfide deposits will be considered an advantage
  • Excellence in generative analysis ranging from new concepts to integration, interpretation, and modeling of large datasets
  • Good field skills and experience conducting field programs across a range of project stages from grassroots prospects through to advanced projects with significant drilling campaigns
  • Baseline level of proficiency in standard desktop software packages (e.g., ArcGIS or QGIS)
  • Strong leadership skills including the ability to motivate and inspire others, to share ownership and responsibility for project outcomes, and to work effectively in collaborative, interdisciplinary teams
  • Previous experience in coaching and training geoscientists of varying experience, educational backgrounds and cultures in leading-practice mineral exploration
  • Demonstrated commitment to high standards of health and safety in the workplace
  • A minimum of 10 years experience in the mineral exploration industry

It is helpful but not required to have:

  • Working knowledge of one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, R, C/C++)
  • Knowledge of geostatistics and/or other statistical methods relevant for analysis of geoscientific data
  • International experience, particularly in the Central African Copperbelt

Note: Candidates who are specialists in geochemistry or geophysics but open to doing significant project work are encouraged to apply.

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

The US base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $110,000-$170,000.

Location: KoBold is a remote-first workplace. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in one of the following countries: United States, Canada, Australia, South Africa, United Kingdom, Zambia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Namibia, Finland, Sweden, or Botswana.

Position Overview:
Creative Chaos is looking for a Senior Supply Chain and Inventory Manager to lead our inventory management and supply chain initiatives. The ideal candidate will have significant experience in supply chain operations and inventory control, understanding the complexities of forecasting, demand planning, and logistics within a fast-paced e-commerce environment. This role requires a proactive leader who can analyze data, drive efficiencies, and strengthen supplier relationships to ensure a seamless flow of products from suppliers to our warehouses and ultimately to our customers.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Supply Chain Strategy Development

  • Develop and implement innovative supply chain strategies to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Analyze supply chain data to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between supply chain goals and organizational objectives.

2. Inventory Management

  • Manage end-to-end inventory control, including tracking levels, forecasting demand, and implementing stock replenishment strategies.
  • Utilize advanced analytics to drive decisions regarding inventory levels at various warehouse locations.
  • Implement best practices for inventory accuracy, ensuring suitable inventory turnover rates.

3. Supplier Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and lead times with suppliers to secure the best possible outcomes for the company.
  • Conduct supplier performance reviews to ensure compliance with contractual obligations.

4. Logistics Coordination

  • Work closely with logistics partners to manage transportation and delivery across all channels.
  • Optimize logistics processes to ensure timely delivery while minimizing costs.
  • Address supply chain disruptions quickly and effectively to minimize impact on operations.

5. Continuous Improvement

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement by developing and implementing key performance indicators (KPIs) for supply chain metrics.
  • Lead projects aimed at enhancing supply chain efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to supply chain and inventory management.

6. Team Leadership and Development

  • Manage a team of supply chain and inventory professionals, providing guidance, mentorship, and training.
  • Promote a collaborative and transparent work environment that encourages team input and engagement.
  • Set clear performance goals and conduct regular performance assessments for direct reports.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field; Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in supply chain and inventory management roles, with at least 3 years in a leadership capacity.
  • Proficient in inventory management systems and related technologies (e.g., ERP systems).
  • Strong understanding of supply chain dynamics and best practices in e-commerce.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data sets and derive actionable insights.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, influence stakeholders, and drive cross-functional collaboration.
  • Excellent negotiation, project management, and communication skills.
  • Certifications such as APICS CPIM, CSCP, or equivalent are a plus.

raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of GPU clusters and other critical IT infrastructure components that power next-generation AI workloads. In this high-impact role, you’ll coordinate engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams to deliver GPU clusters and critical IT infrastructure at hyperscale. You’ll work closely with infrastructure leadership to define strategy, manage risk, and ensure on-time, high-quality launches. You’ll play a key role in scaling our global infrastructure footprint across the United States market.

Travel: This position may require on-site presence at data centers during key deployment phases.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of new data center programs, from design through handover to operations.
  • Define and manage scope, schedule, and risks, maintaining focus on critical paths and proactive issue resolution.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into actionable project plans and measurable deliverables.
  • Oversee vendor and contractor execution, ensuring quality, budget, and schedule.
  • Provide structured program reporting, including dashboards, documentation, and executive updates.

Technical Scope & Expectations

This role requires hands-on experience with physical infrastructure delivery, not only software or coordination-based program management.
You should be comfortable working across multiple layers of infrastructure, including:

  • Data center environments: understanding of IT infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, and networking dependencies before hardware installation);
  • Compute infrastructure: experience with large-scale server deployments (GPU-based systems are a strong plus);
  • Networking: familiarity with high-bandwidth fabrics (e.g., InfiniBand or equivalent), cabling, and integration dependencies;
  • Commissioning & bring-up: exposure to system validation, burn-in testing, and readiness criteria before handover to operations.

You are not expected to be an engineer, but you should be able to:

  • Engage in technical discussions confidently.
  • Identify risks related to infrastructure readiness and sequencing.
  • Challenge assumptions and drive resolution across engineering teams.

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of experience in technical program or project management, with direct involvement in large-scale IT infrastructure deployments.
  • Solid technical background in relevant domains, with the ability to engage deeply in technical discussions and challenge solutions where needed.
  • Proven ability to stay focused on critical paths and drive results in fast-paced, changing environments.
  • Communication and stakeholder management skills; able to translate complex topics clearly.
  • Leadership by influence and example in cross-functional or matrixed teams.
  • Proficient with modern project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Jira, Asana, hybrid Agile/Waterfall).

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Understanding of construction projects structure and key risk factors in facility build-outs.
  • Knowledge of HPC
  • Experience in business processes design or automation tools development.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or similar industry certifications.

Key Employee Benefits in the US:

  • Health Insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
  • 401(k) Plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
  • Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • Remote Work Reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
  • Disability & Life Insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term, and life insurance coverage.

Compensation

We offer competitive salaries ranging from $115K to $275K OTE, which includes base salary and performance bonus. Equity in the form of RSUs may be available at certain salary grades.

Join Nebius Today!

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

About the Client

Our client is a global leading, end-to-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not-for-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

About Teamified

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-

scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and

accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high

performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,

designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

About The Role

We're looking for a mid-level Product Manager to join us in working directly

with customers to understand their pain points and turning individual asks into solutions that scale across our whole customer base. This role sits across web and mobile, with a strong focus on compliance and platform consistency, and partners closely with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting, and Support.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious about customers and how the product works in their hands, who can hold their own in a triad, and who's comfortable making prioritization calls backed by evidence rather than instinct alone.

What you'll work on

  • Work directly with customers to understand pain points and use cases, with a particular focus on customer-raised asks and requests
  • Translate individual customer problems into solutions that can be rolled out to the broader customer base, not just the requesting account
  • Understand and solve for compliance requirements across both web and mobile platforms
  • Translate web features into mobile features, ensuring parity and platform-appropriate design
  • Define and prioritize projects and tasks based on evidence and stakeholder consultation
  • Proactively report on progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership
  • Own and drive product briefs, working in close collaboration with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting (SC), and Support
  • Run gap analyses across multiple areas of the platform to identify where it falls short of customer or compliance needs

Requirements

What you bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in Product Management (or equivalent experience translating customer needs into shipped features)
  • Genuine curiosity about customers and how they use the product
  • Ability to clearly articulate problems, proposed solutions, and recommendations, including the trade-offs behind them
  • Strong communication skills, confident and articulate with customers, internal stakeholders, and engineers alike
  • Demonstrated experience working within a triad model (Product, Engineering, UX) and directly with customers
  • Solid instincts for user experience, knowing what makes a feature usable, not just functional
  • Comfort working across both web and mobile product surfaces

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI tools applied to product workflows
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Experience defining and measuring success metrics for shipped features
  • Ability to uncover common themes across disparate customer feedback

Why this role matters

This PM sits close to the customer, translating real, individual problems into solutions that hold up across the whole platform and customer base. The work directly shapes how consistent, compliant, and usable the product feels across web and mobile, and gives you real ownership over problems from discovery through to delivery.

Benefits

  • Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
  • Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
  • A collaborative, no-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
  • A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
  • Health insurance
  • Leave Benefits
  • Provident Fund
  • Gratuity

If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

raw.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity—guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.

Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Our Customer Service teams support those learners from the front lines, helping them navigate questions, solve problems, and get the most from their experience with Colibri.

Come Build What’s Next

We’re looking for a Training Specialist Customer Service to help our Customer Service Representatives build the knowledge, skills, and confidence they need to deliver exceptional customer experiences across voice, chat, and email.

This is an individual contributor role responsible for new hire onboarding, continuous learning, e-learning development, and performance enablement within a fast-moving Customer Service environment. You’ll build and facilitate learning experiences, identify opportunities for improvement through performance and Quality Assurance insights, and help teams successfully adopt new tools, processes, and ways of working.

We’re looking for someone who can do more than simply deliver training. You should be equally comfortable building an e-learning course from the ground up, facilitating an engaging live session, analyzing where employees need additional support, and consulting with stakeholders to recommend the right learning solution.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and deliver scalable onboarding, e-learning, and continuous learning programs that improve and maintain Customer Service Representative performance

  • Facilitate engaging live virtual and instructor-led training across new hire onboarding, upskilling, process changes, technical topics, and ongoing professional development

  • Partner consultatively with Customer Service leaders, Quality Assurance, and other stakeholders to identify performance gaps and recommend learning solutions, not simply take training requests at face value

  • Use QA trends, learner feedback, KPIs, and post-training performance data to evaluate training effectiveness and identify opportunities for targeted reinforcement or improvement

  • Maintain training programs and operations, including LMS content, course materials, scheduling, completion tracking, readiness documentation, and updates required as tools, technology, products, and processes evolve

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in training, Learning & Development, Customer Service, contact center operations, or a related environment

  • Hands-on experiencedeveloping e-learning and training content, along with demonstrated experience facilitating live virtual and/or instructor-led learning

  • A strong understanding of adult learning principles and the ability to translate complex processes, tools, or information into clear and engaging learning experiences

  • A consultative approach to stakeholder partnership, with the confidence to assess needs, ask thoughtful questions, and recommend solutions based on performance needs

  • Strong communication, presentation, organization, and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a collaborative, evolving environment

A bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Organizational Development, or a related field is helpful, but equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use

Experience with every tool or platform below is not required. We are most interested in your ability to build effective learning experiences, learn new technology quickly, and use data to continuously improve training.

  • Learning Management Systems (LMS)

  • E-learning and digital content development tools

  • Virtual training and collaboration platforms

  • Microsoft Office and productivity tools

  • Quality Assurance, performance reporting, and learner feedback data

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own meaningful training programs that directly influence how prepared and confident our Customer Service Representatives are in supporting customers

  • Build both live and digital learning experiences rather than being limited to facilitating preexisting content

  • Work closely with Customer Service, Quality Assurance, and cross-functional stakeholders to solve real performance challenges

  • Help shape learning programs as Colibri introduces new tools, technologies, processes, and customer service models

  • Join a collaborative, supportive team where your creativity, judgment, and ideas are encouraged and your work will have a visible impact

We Encourage You to Apply

You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! Strong candidates may come from contact center training, Customer Service enablement, corporate Learning & Development, instructional design, technical training, or other high-volume employee learning environments.

However, this role does require hands-on experience developing training or e-learning content and confidently facilitating live learning experiences. If your recent experience has primarily involved coordinating training or delivering materials created entirely by others, this may not provide the depth needed for this particular opportunity.

If you enjoy creating learning experiences, working closely with stakeholders, helping employees grow, and seeing a direct connection between your training and improved performance, we would love to hear from you.

What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process

We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next.

We do not use AI to review applications. Your application is reviewed by a human on our Talent Acquisition team!!

While the exact process may vary slightly by role, you can generally expect:

1. Recruiter Conversation
An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about your experience, career goals, and interest in Colibri. We’ll also share more about the role, team, compensation, and what to expect throughout the process.

2. Hiring Manager Conversation
A deeper discussion with the hiring manager focused on your training and e-learning experience, facilitation approach, stakeholder partnership, and how you approach identifying and solving performance needs.

3. Team and/or Cross-Functional Interviews
Depending on the role, you may meet with future teammates, partners, or leaders you would work closely with. These conversations are designed to explore the experiences most relevant to the position while giving you the opportunity to learn more about how the team works together.

4. Final Conversation and Decision
For some roles, there may be a final conversation with an additional leader or stakeholder. Our Talent Acquisition team will keep you informed about next steps and timing throughout the process.

Our goal is to make the experience thoughtful, respectful, and transparent. We encourage you to ask questions throughout the process—we’re evaluating the opportunity together.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Colibri Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds, experiences, and career paths to apply.

raw.description:
Aviation Program Analyst

Location: Remote (U.S.-based)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking a motivated Aviation Program Analyst to support a growing portfolio of state government, federal, and commercial aviation initiatives focused on Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), Advanced Air Mobility (AAM), airport electrification, and emerging aviation technologies.

This role is ideal for a professional with approximately 3-4 years of experience in aviation, aerospace, transportation, UAS, AAM, airport planning, or a related field. The successful candidate will support program delivery, stakeholder engagement, research and analysis, technical writing, and implementation planning for innovative aviation programs across the United States.

The position provides the opportunity to work directly with state departments of transportation, airports, industry leaders, healthcare systems, utility companies, OEMs and operators of aviation systems, federal agencies, and emerging aviation technology companies helping shape the future of aviation. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting project execution, coordinating stakeholders, developing technical content, and helping clients solve problems through planning work and advisory for the implementation of emerging aviation technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Program and Project Support
    1. Support the successful execution of aviation, UAS, AAM, and airport-related projects and programs.
    2. Maintain project schedules, task trackers, action-item logs, timelines, and project management tools.
    3. Coordinate activities among clients, internal team members, subject matter experts, and external stakeholders.
    4. Assist in the preparation of project status reports, progress updates, meeting summaries, and client communications.
    5. Track project milestones, deliverables, and project risks to help ensure on-time project delivery.
    6. Support program implementation efforts and large-scale aviation initiatives involving government and industry partners.
  2. Research and Analysis
    1. Conduct research on UAS, Advanced Air Mobility, airport electrification, emerging aviation technologies, and related policy developments.
    2. Track and analyze state, local, and federal initiatives supporting advanced aviation integration.
    3. Monitor programs such as FAA eIPP, BEYOND, SMART, and other emerging aviation initiatives.
    4. Support environmental, regulatory, operational, infrastructure, and economic analyses associated with aviation projects.
    5. Develop market assessments, implementation strategies, and industry research summaries.
  3. Stakeholder Engagement
    1. Coordinate outreach efforts with airports, government agencies, industry organizations, private companies, and community stakeholders.
    2. Develop interview guides, surveys, questionnaires, and stakeholder engagement materials.
    3. Conduct virtual and in-person interviews with organizations evaluating UAS and AAM applications, including healthcare, utilities, infrastructure, logistics, emergency response, and construction sectors.
    4. Document findings and prepare recommendations, summaries, and implementation considerations.
  4. Technical Writing and Communications
    1. Draft technical reports, white papers, research papers, case studies, presentations, and briefing materials.
    2. Support the development of thought leadership content related to advanced aviation technologies and implementation strategies.
    3. Prepare client-ready deliverables and executive-level communications.
    4. Assist with proposal development, grant applications, and business growth initiatives.
  5. Industry and Market Intelligence
    1. Track airports, states, utilities, and industry organizations implementing UAS, AAM, and electrification initiatives.
    2. Monitor developments in FAA policy, industry trends, infrastructure investments, and technology adoption.
    3. Maintain awareness of key stakeholders, technology providers, operators, and emerging market opportunities across the advanced aviation ecosystem.
    4. Support development of GIS-based analyses, mapping products, dashboards, and visualization tools to communicate aviation infrastructure, UAS, AAM, and airport planning information to clients and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Aerospace, Transportation Planning, or a related field.
  • Approximately 3-5 years of professional experience supporting aviation, aerospace, transportation, airport planning, UAS, AAM, or related consulting and infrastructure projects.
  • Working knowledge of Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), Advanced Air Mobility (AAM), airport operations, aviation planning, or emerging aviation technologies.
  • Experience supporting project delivery, stakeholder coordination, client engagement, or consulting projects involving multiple organizations and technical subject matter experts.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Ability to synthesize technical, regulatory, operational, and market information into actionable recommendations for clients and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to conduct interviews, facilitate discussions, and engage with industry, government, and airport stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certification or the ability to obtain certification within six months of hire.
  • Experience with airport planning, airport development, Airport Layout Plans (ALPs), aviation infrastructure, or FAA-related projects.
  • Experience supporting AAM, UAS integration, drone operations, remote sensing, photogrammetry, or related technology initiatives.
  • Knowledge of GIS analysis, geospatial data management, web-based mapping applications, or spatial analysis tools.
  • Experience conducting stakeholder outreach, workshops, interviews, surveys, or public engagement activities.
  • Familiarity with federal, state, or local government programs related to aviation, transportation, infrastructure, or emerging technologies.
  • Experience with data visualization, business intelligence, and analytical tools.
  • Participation in aviation industry organizations such as AUVSI, AAAE, NASAO, NBAA, AOPA, or similar professional associations.

Benefits

Crown offers a competitive benefits package including:

• Generous PTO

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans

• Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) with company match

• Life insurance

• Tuition reimbursement

About Crown Innovations

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, and engineering, shaping the future of air transportation through concept development, system design, advanced integration, and emerging technologies. Our expertise spans air traffic management, survey administration, lifecycle data management for informed decision-making, infrastructure sustainment and modernization, and National Airspace System (NAS) integration.

For more than three decades, Crown has partnered with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), NASA, the Energy Information Administration (EIA), state and local governments, and commercial organizations to deliver innovative engineering, strategic planning, software development, data analytics, modeling and simulation, regulatory compliance, and advanced information solutions that enhance national infrastructure, operational performance, and mission success.

As a prime contractor supporting several high-impact federal programs, Crown is committed to delivering innovative, reliable, and customer-focused solutions while fostering a culture of collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.

Crown has consistently been recognized as one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC metropolitan area by investing in exceptional people who are passionate about supporting our customers' missions and driving meaningful innovation.

Compliance & Equal Opportunity

Persons unable to complete an online application should contact Crown HR for assistance at (703) 650-0663 ext. 3068.

As a government contractor, certain positions may require U.S. citizenship.

Crown is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

EOE: Disability/Veterans

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Crown Innovations, Inc. is a dynamic and growing organization providing professional services and operational support solutions to government and commercial customers nationwide. We are committed to delivering exceptional service through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence.

raw.description:
About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.

Get to know the Special Programs Team

The Special Programs team delivers high-impact, fast-paced services that help organizations accelerate their compliance journey. Unlike our standard offerings, Special Programs are purpose-built engagements designed to solve specific customer challenges, from establishing a compliance foundation in 30 days to migrating organizations onto new GRC platforms, supporting audits, and delivering other specialized compliance services.

For many customers, Special Programs represent their first experience working with Workstreet. Because of that, we are laser-focused on speed, quality, and an exceptional customer experience that builds trust from day one. We support hundreds of organizations, from early-stage startups to global enterprises, across nearly every industry.

The Opportunity

Workstreet is seeking a highly motivated, client-focused GRC Engineer to join our fast-growing team. Built around client relationship excellence, this role focuses on delivering exceptional client experiences, cultivating trust, and driving program outcomes while managing accounts and overseeing a pod of analysts across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

The successful candidate will integrate quickly into the organization and manage active client accounts within their first 15 days. You will serve as the dedicated primary point of contact for a portfolio of accounts, guiding engagements end-to-end, resolving escalations with composure and urgency, and ensuring every client interaction reflects the highest standard of service.

What you'll do

  • Execute end-to-end client compliance initiatives - assist in implementing and maintaining client security compliance programs aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regulatory standards.
  • Maintain policy and evidence repositories - author and update corporate security policies, standard operating procedures, and control evidence to support formal audits and assessments.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks - partner with cross-functional technical teams to track, evaluate, and remediate cybersecurity risks and control gaps.
  • Manage project deliverables and timelines - track compliance milestones, evidence gathering, and task execution across concurrent client engagements under senior guidance.
  • Drive direct client communications - engage directly with client stakeholders via email, chat, and video calls to gather evidence, clarify control requirements, and share updates.
  • Perform control testing and readiness reviews - conduct structured control evaluations and readiness checks to maintain continuous compliance alignment.
  • Partner cross-functionally on remediation - collaborate with internal IT, security, and operations teams to execute corrective action plans and improve compliance posture.
  • Contribute to operational process scaling - receive mentorship from senior leaders while updating delivery templates, playbooks, and standard operating procedures.

Who you are

  • Direct client engagement operator - proven ability to communicate directly with U.S. clients, maintaining professionalism and executive care across all touchpoints.
  • Multi-project GRC operator - bring strong organizational discipline to manage multiple cybersecurity compliance engagements simultaneously without losing velocity.
  • Technical compliance practitioner - hands-on execution experience across SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF frameworks within tech-focused cybersecurity environments.
  • Policy lifecycle architect - practical familiarity authoring, rolling out, and enforcing enterprise cybersecurity policies and control benchmarks.
  • High-velocity startup operator - thrives in fast-paced startup settings, adapting quickly to shifting priorities and dynamic client challenges.
  • Exceptional technical communicator - possesses outstanding written and verbal English communication skills suited for executive and technical interactions.

What help you succeed

  • Compliance automation platform mastery - practical exposure utilizing automated compliance solutions such as Vanta or similar GRC platforms.
  • Expanded regulatory framework knowledge - practical familiarity with additional regulatory frameworks including GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.
  • Active industry certifications - credentialed practitioner holding recognized certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CISA, or Security+.

What we offer

  • Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities.
  • Role-Related Training: Reimbursement for the successful completion of approved training and certification courses relevant to your current role.
  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
  • Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
  • Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

What you'll need to thrive

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams.
  • A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration.
  • Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET) to effectively collaborate with team members, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners while ensuring timely communication and support.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally for occasional onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities as needed.

Hiring and Selection Process

At Anchorage Digital, we are building the world’s most advanced digital asset platform for institutions to participate in crypto.
Anchorage Digital is a crypto platform that enables institutions to participate in digital assets through custody, staking, trading, governance, settlement, and the industry's leading security infrastructure. Home to Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., the first federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., Anchorage Digital also serves institutions through Anchorage Digital Singapore, Porto by Anchorage Digital, and other offerings.
The company is funded by leading institutions including Andreessen Horowitz, GIC, Goldman Sachs, KKR, and Visa, with its Series D valuation over $3 billion. Founded in 2017 in San Francisco, California, Anchorage Digital has offices in New York, New York; Porto, Portugal; Singapore; and Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Learn more at anchorage.com, on X @Anchorage, and on LinkedIn.

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. We believe that a laptop can be shipped, but our culture cannot.

Anchorage Digital is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Credit Trader to drive revenue growth and institutional adoption of our Prime Financing platform. Our Prime Financing business is a high-growth business line within the Global Markets franchise, specializing in originating structured lending and credit solutions that solve capital constraints for the world's leading crypto-native and TradFi institutions.
In this role, you will be responsible for structuring, pricing, and managing bespoke credit facilities, including margin lending, delayed settlement tradins, and collateralized loan agreements using BTC, ETH, and other digital assets. You will work closely with our sales and risk teams to convert our pipeline, manage credit exposure, and deliver capital-efficient financing solutions. This role requires strong attention to detail, creativity, sense of risk management, and a team-player mindset.

As a Credit Trader you will:

  • Execute a variety of credit structures, from credit agreements to control agreements.
  • Develop new credit structures, agreements, and documentation as the loan portfolio mix changes.
  • Take a solutions-based approach to originating solutions to client needs and drive revenue growth in diverse market conditions
  • Negotiate, prepare, and close all legal contracts within the lending business.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to qualify and structure credit opportunities to scale our lending business.
  • Move and track collateral across multiple venues and business lines in order to optimize utilization, yield and funding
  • Create detailed memos and runbooks on operationalization of current as well future funding facilities across CeFi and DeFi
  • Originate and manage key external funding partner relationships
  • Regularly analyze risks levels and market trends to identify areas of optimization and lead improvements

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience in credit trading and/or financial products structuring. Experience at a tier 1 investment bank strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of crypto markets, especially as relates to financing. Experience with lending or related role at a top crypto platform strongly preferred.
  • Experience structuring and developing complex financial products with large institutions as well as startups.
  • Strong familiarity with legal and regulatory requirements for US financial products.
  • Experience building strong cross-functional partnerships with legal, operations, compliance, sales and business teams.
  • A highly collaborative, team player mindset
  • An entrepreneurial drive, with the creativity and initiative to deliver solutions to client demand and generate revenue.
  • Strong risk management acumen and experience developing processes and control frameworks to ensure sustainable, risk-managed growth.
  • A detail-oriented and highly organized method of working
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills

Although not a requirement, bonus points if:

  • Ability to write scripts (e.g., Bash scripts, Python scripts) to automate manual processes and familiarity with Python for data manipulation and analysis
  • You have a law degree and/or an advanced degree in Financial Engineering (or a related quantitative discipline).
  • You’ve kept up to date with crypto derivatives strategies and defi ecosystem

About Anchorage Digital: Who we are

The Anchorage Village, what we call our team, brings together the brightest minds from platform security, financial services, and distributed ledger technology to provide the building blocks that empower institutions to safely participate in the evolving digital asset ecosystem. As a diverse team of more than 600 members, we are united in one common goal: building the future of finance by providing the foundation upon which value moves safely in the new global economy.
Anchorage Digital is committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported, and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.
Anchorage Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. Anchorage Digital considers qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with other legal requirements. “Anchorage Digital” refers to services that are offered either through Anchorage Digital Bank National Association, an OCC-chartered national trust bank, or Anchorage Lending CA, LLC a finance lender licensed by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, License No. 60DBO-11976, or Anchorage Digital Singapore Pte Ltd, a Singapore private limited company, all wholly-owned subsidiaries of Anchor Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation.

Job Description:

M&A Research & Data Analyst - Vesta Software Group UK

Vesta Software Group specialises in acquiring, managing, and growing software companies across diverse industries, with a primary focus on Europe and Latin America. As a subsidiary of Constellation Software—one of the world's largest acquirers of software businesses—Vesta provides a unique opportunity to be part of a dynamic, fast-paced M&A environment. Our portfolio has recently expanded with acquisitions such as Béker-Soft Informatika Kft. (Hungary), Dataflow Events & MWC Partners (UK), and Amisoft (Latin America).

As an M&A Research & Data Analyst, you will play a vital role in identifying and evaluating acquisition opportunities, conducting in-depth market research, and supporting the overall M&A process. This position offers a unique chance to gain hands-on experience in software acquisitions, working closely with industry experts.

Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities (80%+)

  • Acquisition Target Analysis: Evaluate potential acquisition targets using our investment criteria.

  • Carve-Out Identification: Assess corporations to identify viable carve-out opportunities.

  • Big Data Management: Maintain and oversee data integrity within our CRM, ensuring accuracy of KPIs and dashboards.

  • Market Research: Conduct detailed market analysis on new verticals and geographies to support expansion efforts.

  • M&A Advisor Mapping: Identify and map relevant software M&A advisors, from global firms to boutique consultancies.

  • Data Source Evaluation: Research and assess third-party data sources, industry lists, and trade conferences.

Secondary Responsibilities (Less than 20%)

  • Transaction Support: Assist in due diligence processes, including market analysis, contract review, and competitor research.

  • Ad Hoc Research Projects: Support Business Development Executives and Group Leaders with specialized research initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Finance, or Engineering.

  • Fluency in English and German.

  • Experience in Research and/or Financial Services is preferred.

Preferred Attributes:

  • Strong analytical mindset and intellectual curiosity.

  • Interest in the software and technology sectors.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with the ability to manipulate data from multiple sources.

  • Solid understanding of research methodologies and M&A origination processes.

What We Offer

  • M&A & Investment Experience: Gain practical, hands-on exposure to the entire M&A process.

  • Comprehensive Industry Exposure: Work alongside one of the world’s largest acquirers of software businesses.

  • Real-World Application: Utilize industry-leading M&A tools and data sources in an active acquisition environment.

  • Flexible Work Arrangements: Benefit from a flexible work-from-home policy.

Pallas M&A

37.5

1

Regular

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

The Director, Advanced Practice Provider (APP) Services provides leadership, direction, and resource stewardship to The US Oncology Network (The Network) and is responsible for aligning APP objectives with The Network’s affiliated practices’ vision and strategy.

The Director of APP Services works collaboratively with The Network practices, leadership, and McKesson/USON leadership to implement processes and procedures to ensure the delivery of high-quality comprehensive patient care. He/she has responsibility for leading and further developing Network strategy for optimally positioning APPs within new and innovative models of care that increase the value equation for clinical care delivery across all geographies, specialties, and care sites. Provides leadership and direction to internal McKesson, as well as affiliated practice leadership teams for developing and implementing pioneering methods to achieve Network goals through high-performing care teams, enhanced APP integration of APPs, and optimization of APP care operations.

The ideal candidate will identify and execute on a variety of operational and strategic initiatives that optimize the support of The Network practices with three primary goals: 1) strengthening the operational and financial performance of the practices through APP integration 2) further developing operational and financial frameworks that position The Network as a preferred employer of APPs practicing in community oncology/surgery setting and 3) improving the quality of multi-disciplinary high-value care through maximizing the role of the APP within Network practices.

Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Pharmacy Technician, Clinic Support delivers accurate, responsive service to clinic customers while enabling prescription and order processing across Empower. Operating within a hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A/503B environment, this role owns inquiry resolution, transaction support, documentation accuracy, shipment tracking, billing coordination, and escalation of complex issues. The technician serves as a trusted contact for clinics, communicates clearly across multiple channels, and collaborates with internal teams to resolve concerns without compromising privacy, quality, or compliance. Success requires disciplined execution, empathy, sound judgment, analytical problem-solving, and the learning agility to adapt as priorities and requirements evolve. Through precise follow-through and accountable service, this role strengthens customer relationships, protects operational continuity, supports compliant pharmacy workflows, and advances Empower’s ability to expand access to innovative, affordable medications for the patients and providers we serve.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Clinic Customer Support

  • Inquiry Resolution: Respond to clinic prescription inquiries, post-sale transactions, and complaints professionally, empathetically, and within the established 24-hour service expectation.
  • Channel Communication: Communicate accurate updates through phone, email, fax, and internal messaging while maintaining clear ownership through issue resolution.
  • Relationship Support: Build dependable clinic relationships by understanding customer needs, setting realistic expectations, and following through consistently on commitments.

Prescription And Order Accuracy

  • Prescription Processing: Coordinate with internal teams to support accurate, timely processing of prescriptions and office orders while promptly resolving discrepancies.
  • Record Maintenance: Maintain complete records of customer interactions, transactions, shipment status, and billing activity to support accurate operational follow-through.
  • Issue Escalation: Identify concerns requiring specialized support and escalate them with complete context to Account Management, sales, or appropriate internal partners.

Quality And Compliance

  • Privacy Protection: Protect confidential information by following Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act requirements and established company standards in every interaction.
  • Shipment Tracking: Monitor shipment progress, communicate relevant updates, and address delivery concerns promptly to preserve service continuity and customer confidence.
  • Workflow Improvement: Recognize recurring service or processing issues, recommend practical improvements, and apply approved changes that strengthen accuracy and efficiency.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Knowledge of pharmacy law, medical terminology, dosage measurements, and prescription-processing requirements supporting accurate, compliant daily clinic service operations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook for communication, record maintenance, shipment tracking, billing support, and issue documentation.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills for communicating clearly and empathetically with clinics, physicians, customers, and internal departments.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills, close attention to detail, and sound judgment when resolving inquiries, identifying discrepancies, and determining appropriate escalation.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Registration with the Texas State Board of Pharmacy as a Pharmacy Technician is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate accurately across phone, email, fax, and messaging channels while managing multiple service priorities required.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook, plus analytical and mathematical skills needed to process and interpret information accurately required.
  • At least two years of pharmacy and customer service experience supporting clinics, providers, or comparable customer-facing operations preferred.
  • College coursework or a degree in a science-related field that strengthens understanding of pharmacy and medication-related information required.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more:

Physical Requirements:

While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to remain in a stationary position for a significant amount of the workday and frequently use their hands and fingers to handle or feel in order to access, input, and retrieve information from the computer and other office productivity devices. Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

GMP Auditor - Remote

Intertek, a leading provider of quality and safety solutions to many of the world’s top-recognized brands and companies, is actively seeking a Pharma, Dietary Supplement and Cosmetic GMP Auditor to join our Remote Business Assurance team. This is a fantastic opportunity to grow a versatile career in GMP Auditing

Intertek's Business Assurance team goes beyond testing, inspection and certification to look at the underlying elements that make a company and its products successful. Our assurance solutions provide confidence and total peace of mind that a client's operating procedures, systems and people are functioning properly to provide a competitive advantage in the marketplace. Intertek is continually innovating and evolving to reduce risk for consumers, brands and organizations in every sector and industry around the world. We go beyond Testing, Inspection and Certification of products: we are a Total Quality Assurance Provider to industries worldwide. Our Purpose: Bringing quality, safety, and sustainability to life.

What are we looking for?

This is a full-time position, with the person primarily responsible for performing GMP compliance supplier audits to assure that client’s products have been manufactured, tested, handled and stored in compliance with applicable FDA or other country specific regulations and client specific requirements. This position will travel at least 50% to 75% of the time.

Salary & Benefits Information

Individual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate including skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

In addition to competitive compensation packages, when working with Intertek you can expect benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, 401(k) with company match, generous vacation / sick time (PTO), tuition reimbursement and more.

What you’ll do:

  • Plan, prepare, and conduct of facility audits in support of GMP as directed.
    • Create Audit Plans and Agendas, and send to site;
    • Hold Opening and Closing Meetings;
    • Interview and observe operations in situ.
  • Assemble and coordinate the activities of the audit team.
  • Interpret policies, standards, and regulations, and then evaluates potentially critical problems not covered by policies, standards, and regulations.
  • Assess compliance with applicable FDA, or country specific regulations and guidelines, and/or the client’s requirements and specifications.
  • Advise office immediately of any critical observations identified during audit.
  • Ensure that written procedures are followed, and exercise judgment in evaluating quality systems, processes, procedures, and protocols for compliance.
  • Review SOPs to ensure procedures and systems used in the regulated processes, such as manufacturing and testing, are in compliance with applicable regulations and guidelines, including documented procedures for OOS, recalls, deviations, complaints, CAPA, QA responsibilities, batch record review and batch disposition.
  • Appropriately escalate any compliance issues.
  • Communicate audit results to management and auditees through written audit reports.
  • Draft and Submit Audit Report for internal review.
  • Manage post-audit activities (e.g.: CAPA assessment and review) and follow up on any necessary corrective and preventive actions by resolving any conflicts.
  • Manage and ensure all travel arrangements are in compliance with applicable travel policies.
  • Maintain current knowledge of industry standards and expectations.

This position outline is a general guideline and does not represent all encompassing details. The position assumes that the incumbent has both the mental and physical requirements to carry out the above defined duties.

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Accredited Quality Auditor Certification through ASQ, ANAB, IRCA or other recognized auditor training body meeting ISO/IEC 17021 (for management system certification bodies) or ISO/IEC 17065 (for product/process certification bodies).
  • A four-year college/university degree in a science or technical field (biology or microbiology; chemistry or biochemistry; computer and software technology; electrical, electronic, mechanical or bioengineering; human physiology; medicine; pharmacy; physics or biophysics) or equivalent combination of relevant education and work experience.
