raw.description:
The opportunity

People Operations is the operational and employee experience engine of Cint's People function. In this global leadership role, you will own the services, processes and infrastructure that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle.

This is equal parts operational leadership and transformation. You will make sure the fundamentals - employee support, Employee Relations, HRIS, data, policies, documentation and benefits - work brilliantly, while building a more scalable, technology-enabled operating model.

Working across People Partnering, Talent, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards and People Technology, you will simplify how work gets done and decide what belongs in self-service, automation or AI, and where human judgement and specialist expertise add the greatest value.

Help us build a simpler, smarter and more human People Operations model - one that delivers an excellent experience today and scales for what comes next.

What you will do

  • Employee Support & ER: Lead a responsive, high-quality first line of People support, with clear service levels, effective case management and risk-based escalation. Build the team's capability to resolve a broader range of standard Employee Relations matters confidently and consistently.

  • Simple, Scalable Processes: Own and continuously improve core employee-lifecycle processes, the People knowledge hub, policies and guidance. Create simple ownership, handoffs and escalation paths, balancing global consistency with local requirements.

  • Trusted Systems & Data: Own the operational performance of our HRIS and People data, strengthening accuracy, controls and governance. Partner with People Technology on workflows, integrations and system improvements that work for employees and the business.

  • AI, Automation & Self-Service: Build effective ticketing, knowledge and self-service experiences. Redesign work before automating it, introduce AI-enabled workflows where they create genuine value, and measure the impact through experience, quality, speed, scalability and capacity created.

  • People Operations Transformation: Set and deliver the People Operations roadmap, moving the function from transactional execution towards problem-solving, employee experience and operational consulting. Use service insights to identify root causes and broader organisational opportunities.

  • Global Benefits Operations: Lead the operational management of Cint’s global benefits portfolio, partnering with Total Rewards to deliver strong implementation, governance, vendor management and employee experience.

How you'll lead

  • Coach and develop a high-performing global People Operations and Employee Relations team, building capability across support, ER, process design, systems, AI, automation, data and employee experience.

  • Lead a blended workforce of people and AI agents, designing clear roles, workflows and accountability so human judgement and AI capability combine to deliver better, faster and more scalable outcomes.

  • Create a culture that owns outcomes, solves problems at their root and moves comfortably between strategy and hands-on execution.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience leading a global People Operations, HR Operations, Shared Services, Employee Experience or related function - including developing global teams.

  • Strong operational knowledge across employee support, Employee Relations, HRIS, People data, policies and the employee lifecycle.

  • A track record of transforming operations: simplifying processes, improving service delivery and implementing workflow, self-service, automation or AI-enabled solutions.

  • Experience establishing effective case management, ticketing or tiered support models, with sound judgement about what can be standardised and what needs deeper expertise or context.

  • Strong systems thinking, analytical capability and stakeholder management, with the ability to connect technology, process, policy, roles and employee experience.

  • Curiosity about AI and emerging technology, balanced with pragmatism about where it genuinely creates value.

It would be a bonus if you have

Experience with AI-enabled HR workflows; HiBob or similar platforms; global Shared Services transformation; employee self-service or knowledge management; and/or a fast-moving international technology business.

If you are known for turning complexity into simple, scalable ways of working - and want to shape the future of People Operations at Cint - we'd love to hear from you.

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

Who We Are

Cint is the technology foundation for continuous research and measurement. With a global footprint and programmatic access to hundreds of millions of consumers across 130+ countries, Cint connects researchers, advertisers, and brands to reliable data from the world’s largest network of high-quality sources. Researchers can collect human and advanced data at speed. Advertisers and their partners can measure campaign effectiveness at scale. Brands can move from insight to action with clarity. By operating the connective layer between asking questions and measuring advertising outcomes, Cint enables organizations to move faster and make confident business decisions.

At Cint, we’re feeding the world’s curiosity.

raw.description:
At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.


About the Role

Sunrun is seeking a Staff Technical Product Manager to build and scale products within our growing AI organization. In this role, you will partner closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to turn complex operational and customer needs into high-impact AI capabilities.

Spanning the full product lifecycle—from early discovery and prototyping to launch, adoption, and scaling—you will work alongside an existing Product Manager and a team of 30+ engineers to shape solutions across both B2B and B2C use cases.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: Guide product initiatives through discovery, requirements definition, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • Product Strategy: Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear product roadmaps, requirements, and prioritized backlogs aligned with Sunrun's overarching goals.

  • Technical Partnership: Collaborate closely with engineering teams on system design discussions, architectural trade-offs, and complex implementation choices.

  • Metrics & Measurement: Define upfront KPIs and leverage post-launch data to evaluate product impact and guide future investments.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Communicate vision, priorities, and investment rationale clearly to both technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Constructive Leadership: Provide thoughtful pushback when requests misalign with business goals, build consensus, and drive disciplined execution.

Qualifications

  • 7+ Years Experience: Demonstrated track record in product management and technical roles owning complex, scalable products.

  • Technical Foundation: Deep fluency in software systems, enabling meaningful engagement with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

  • Scale & Execution: Experience bringing products from 0-to-1 and scaling established platforms to drive sustained user adoption.

  • Navigating Ambiguity: Proven ability to turn broad, unstructured problems into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.

  • Data-Driven Mindset: History of defining success metrics and delivering concrete business or customer value.

  • Communication & Influence: Strong strategic judgment with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and align cross-functional teams.

Finix is building the global operating system for fintech, starting with payments. From startups to publicly traded companies, Finix processes tens of billions of dollars annually both in-store and online. Finix was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco.

Finix is seeking a Partnership Success Manager to own the health, growth, and productivity of our partnerships after they're signed. While our Strategic Partnerships Managers focus on sourcing and closing, you'll take the baton at close and turn those relationships into a reliable, scaling source of qualified pipeline and revenue.

You'll be the day-to-day owner of our partner portfolio, responsible for onboarding partners, driving Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs), and keeping partners engaged and productive. This role is ideal for someone highly organized, relationship-driven, and energized by operational execution, comfortable managing many partners at once and obsessive about follow-through.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales to ensure partner-sourced leads are followed up on and progressing through pipeline
  • Support partners with ongoing enablement, including marketing collateral, co-selling support, and answers to product or process questions
  • Track and report on partner performance metrics, including SAO volume, pipeline contribution, and sourced revenue by partner
  • Build and refine repeatable processes for partner onboarding, enablement, and ongoing success as the program scales

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in partner management, customer success, account management, or a related relationship-management role, ideally at a high-growth SaaS or payments company
  • Track record of managing a portfolio of relationships and driving measurable outcomes (pipeline, revenue, retention, or engagement)
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle many partners and tasks simultaneously
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across both internal teams and external partners
  • Comfort with operational and administrative work, including CRM hygiene, reporting, and process management

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer within Zillow’s Rich Media Experiences team, you’ll join a group focused on helping people better understand homes through immersive, AI-powered experiences. The team works on turning photos, video, and spatial signals into structured representations that power customer-facing products used by millions of shoppers. Within Rich Media Experiences, the Instant Floor Plans team is building systems that transform sensor-rich mobile captures into accurate floor plans and 3D representations that feed Zillow’s rich-media and listing experiences.

About the role

This is a high-impact senior individual contributor role for someone who loves operating at the intersection of modeling and systems. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll help shape how Zillow builds production-grade machine learning systems for rich media experiences, partnering across applied science and engineering to turn promising ideas into reliable, scalable product capabilities.

You Will Get To:

  • Design, build, and operate production-grade machine learning systems that move from early ideas and prototypes into reliable customer-facing services.

  • Lead end-to-end machine learning work spanning data, training, evaluation, deployment, observability, and iteration in production.

  • Partner closely with applied scientists and software engineers across backend, web, and mobile to integrate modern machine learning techniques into Zillow experiences.

  • Improve the quality, latency, reliability, and maintainability of machine learning workflows that support floor plan and rich media products.

  • Drive technical decisions in ambiguous problem spaces, especially where structured inference, computer vision, spatial signals, or performance tradeoffs matter.

  • Help establish shared patterns, tooling, and best practices that raise the bar for machine learning engineering across the team.

  • Mentor peers through strong technical execution, code review, debugging discipline, and thoughtful communication across functions.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $171,700.00 - $274,300.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $163,200.00 - $260,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You have significant professional experience building and shipping machine learning models or ML-powered systems in production.

  • You have strong hands-on proficiency in Python and at least one modern machine learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • You have experience building and operating end-to-end machine learning workflows, including data pipelines, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals such as representation learning, structured prediction, computer vision, optimization, and failure analysis.

  • You are comfortable debugging model and system behavior in real-world environments and using metrics, logs, and experiments to improve outcomes.

  • You collaborate effectively with applied scientists, software engineers, and product partners in ambiguous, cross-functional settings.

  • You have strong engineering judgment and know how to balance experimentation with reliability, speed, and long-term maintainability.

  • You communicate technical ideas clearly and can influence decisions across disciplines.

  • Experience in computer vision, spatial data, 3D, AR/VR, mapping, search, recommendation systems, or related domains is a plus.

Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

LocationOur Manager of Sales, Attribute, EMEA, will be leading a team of Account Executives in EMEA, focusing on our direct sales motion for the Attribute product. This role is based remotely anywhere in the UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden or Estonia.

Who We AreJoin the newly acquired Attribute team. DoiT recently acquired Attribute, a team of technologists building the tech disrupting FinOps: real-time, tagless cost attribution for cloud and AI spend. This is a rare shot at joining the founding GTM org for a fast-scaling product, backed by a company already trusted by 4,000+ customers worldwide.

DoiT is a global technology company that helps cloud-driven organizations harness the cloud to drive growth and innovation, combining data, technology, and human expertise to keep customers well-architected and scalable from planning to production. Through DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution pairing advanced technology with real human expertise, we solve complex multicloud problems at scale. With decades of multicloud experience and deep specialization in Kubernetes, GenAI, and CloudOps, DoiT is an award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

About Attribute by DoiTAttribute disrupted the AI and cloud space with FinOps Without Tagging. While organizations pause AI investment over uncontrolled spend and limited visibility, Attribute gives enterprises a way to see AI cost attributed to the exact customer, agent, or team driving it, based on actual consumption. Built by a team coming from the cybersecurity community and top global institutions, we've created the most advanced FinOps technology since the cloud itself. Attribute translates complex cloud and AI network signals into simple business insights, margins per customer, COGS, TCO, showback, making it immediately attractive to every DevOps and infrastructure buyer.

The Opportunity
As a Manager of Sales, Attribute, EMEA, you will lead and scale the North America enterprise sales business for the Attribute product. You will manage a team of approximately 4-6 Enterprise Account Executives while owning regional revenue, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy.

This is a business leadership role. You will operate the region as a business within the business, driving predictable growth, accelerating new logo acquisition, and building a high-performance team selling into cloud-native and Kubernetes-focused organizations.

We are looking for a leader who has experience:

  • Owning their business and treating their territory like their own company with a high degree of accountability.
  • Putting people first while holding a high bar for performance
  • Understands Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure
  • Making decisions based on data, metrics, and experience
  • Winning through collaboration

Responsibilities

Own the Business

  • Drive new enterprise logo acquisition across EMEA
  • Increase market penetration and brand presence within target accounts
  • Own revenue, pipeline generation, and forecast accuracy for EMEA
  • Build and execute a regional GTM strategy focused on Kubernetes-heavy accounts
  • Maintain strong pipeline coverage and conversion metrics across all sales stages
  • Drive weekly pipeline inspection and deal review cadence grounded in data
  • Ensure consistent attainment of quarterly and annual targets

Lead and Develop a High-Performance Team

  • Recruit, hire, and develop top-performing Enterprise AEs
  • Create a culture of accountability, growth, and ownership
  • Provide structured coaching on deal strategy, qualification, negotiation, and closing
  • Deliver clear performance feedback and development plans

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Establish a data-driven sales culture where decisions are based on metrics.
  • Own forecast accuracy and CRM hygiene
  • Analyze trends in win rates, ACV, sales cycle, and pipeline velocity
  • Partner with RevOps to continuously refine dashboards, KPIs, and reporting
  • Identify friction points in the sales process and improve speed to close

Support Strategic Deals

  • Act as an escalation point for complex enterprise deals
  • Lead pricing, approval, and negotiation strategy when required
  • Personally engage in high-impact opportunities when needed

Qualifications

  • 3+ years leading quota-carrying Enterprise Account Executives in a SaaS company
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding team revenue targets
  • Demonstrated excellence in pipeline management, sales forecasting, and performance analytics
  • Strong experience operating in data-driven sales environments (Salesforce proficiency required)
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes, cloud-native architectures, and DevOps environments
  • Ability to engage in technical infrastructure conversations with credibility
  • Strong business acumen and ownership mentality
  • Exceptional coaching and people leadership skills
  • Clear communicator with executive presence
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving SaaS environment
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points

Experience selling Kubernetes-related, observability, or cloud optimization tools

  • Experience building or scaling a new enterprise sales motion

Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One TeamDoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal, it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

raw.description:
Position: Revenue Operations Analyst II

Department: Revenue Operations

Location: India(Remote)

Shift: 2 pm -11 pm IST

About Us

HighLevel is a cloud-based, all-in-one white-label marketing and sales platform that empowers marketing agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, from marketing agencies to entrepreneurs to small businesses and beyond. Our platform empowers users across industries to streamline operations, drive growth, and crush their goals. HighLevel processes over 15 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million domain names.

Our People

With over 2000+ team members across 15+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark - and we get to help make that happen.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

You are a player-coach with genuine analytical depth and a builder's instinct. You do not wait to be asked what matters before it becomes urgent and bring recommendations, not just observations. You identify trends, gaps, and opportunities and share insights with relevant stakeholders. You are comfortable walking into a room of experienced GTM leaders and supporting them with data and insights. You see broken workflows as problems to fix, not facts of life, and you have the operational credibility to implement the fix yourself. You thrive on unstructured problems and ambiguity is your baseline, not your blocker.

About the Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst in the team. In this role, you'll own analytics, reporting, and process for a dedicated segment of the revenue org becoming the go-to person who turns raw performance data into the reporting, programs, and workflows that team runs on day to day. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who's equally comfortable building a dashboard, designing a process from scratch, and troubleshooting a broken workflow, and who wants a direct line of sight into how their work moves the business.

What You'll Do

Analytics & Reporting

  • Own and manage all performance analytics and reporting for your assigned segment, giving leadership a clear, real-time view of how the business is performing
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and recurring reports that leadership relies on to make decisions
  • Own program attribution — the tracking, operations, and reporting that connect activity to outcomes

Process & Program Development

  • Design, build, and optimize end-to-end processes for your segment, from initial concept to rollout and iteration
  • Own pipeline/workflow management for your segment, identifying bottlenecks and driving improvements

Strategic Initiatives & Performance

  • Track performance against goals and KPIs for your segment, flagging gaps early and calling out what's working
  • Identify growth opportunities by digging into the data where conversion is leaking, where capacity is underused, where a small change could move a big number
  • Build the business case for new initiatives: scope the opportunity, size the impact, and get leadership buy-in
  • Execute initiatives end-to-end, from planning through rollout, adjusting as you go based on what the data shows
  • Report on initiative outcomes against the original goals, and use those learnings to shape what you tackle next

Tools, Systems & Automation

  • Build, own, and maintain the backend workflows and automations that power your segment's day-to-day operations in the HighLevel’s CRM
  • Leverage AI solutions for reporting, dashboards, and analysis

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as the analytics and operations partner to your segment's leadership — meeting with them regularly (e.g., weekly) to review progress, surface issues, and align on priorities
  • Support onboarding, training, and change management when new processes or tools roll out
  • Fulfill ad hoc requests from leadership, prioritizing and scoping work independently

What We're Looking For

  • 2-4 years of experience in business/revenue analysis, sales/marketing operations, or a related analytical or operational field
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL; experience with a BI tool (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) strongly preferred
  • Hands-on experience with a CRM (Salesforce preferred) and comfort building within or alongside GTM systems and automation platforms
  • Proven ability to build a process or program from scratch — scoping it, standing it up, and iterating based on results
  • Experience building or maintaining backend workflows, automations, or internal tools (no-code/low-code platforms, Zapier, workflow builders, etc. are a plus)
  • Strong attribution/tracking instincts — comfortable connecting activity data to outcomes and building reporting that holds up to scrutiny
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex analysis into a clear narrative for leadership audiences
  • A track record of operating independently in ambiguous situations, troubleshooting systems issues, and driving work to resolution
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis is a plus, not a requirement

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Director, Regional Actuarial to join our Actuarial team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Senior Director, Regional Actuarial, plays an instrumental role in Oscar's enterprise Pricing function, influences and guides a team to drive actions in support of Oscar's ACA Individual market strategies and financial goals. As a key driver of pricing excellence within the organization, the Senior Director collaborates closely with analytical and business leads across Finance, Market P&L, Insurance Product, Medical Economics, and Government Affairs to ensure progress towards the company's strategic growth objectives.   • 12+ years of quantitative analysis in the healthcare industry.
  • 5+ years of collaborating and influencing the Executive Leadership Committee.
  • Proven experience in a pricing role, or a related analytics-driven leadership role.

Bonus points:

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Supply Chain Manager

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will establish and manage the end-to-end external supply chain for Amgen’s new product portfolio. The Supply Chain Manager will drive supply planning, material readiness, and delivery of pre-clinical, clinical, and PPQ products manufactured at Amgen’s Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).

The role will partner with Global Supply Chain, Product Teams, Amgen Contract Manufacturing, CMOs, and other cross-functional partners to design and implement supply chain solutions for new external manufacturing sites. The Supply Chain Manager will translate program demand and manufacturing requirements into executable supply plans, assess supply constraints and risks, and coordinate mitigation actions to enable timely decisions and reliable supply.

The goal for this position is to deliver supply in the right product quantity to the right location at the right time, while optimizing inventory and cost within contractual terms, eliminating stock-out and scrap exposure, and improving the overall supply risk profile.

  • Driving and supporting site-level implementation of Amgen’s integrated business processes, including Plan-to-Stock, Order-to-Cash, and handoff processes with CMOs and internal functions.

  • Developing and maintaining executable supply plans and conducting capacity and inventory scenario analyses to evaluate options and inform program decisions.

  • Assessing CMO supply chain readiness, including capabilities, manufacturing capacity, lead times, critical raw material requirements, and other constraints; coordinating mitigation actions to protect supply continuity.

  • Overseeing timely, compliant execution of assigned site-level supply chain operations and financial flows, including inventory, order and invoice management, and coordination of material movements.

  • Establishing and maintaining applicable SAP and RapidResponse master data and ensuring accurate, compliant system transactions.

  • Ensuring applicable operating standards and supply chain requirements for technology transfer and new product introduction are implemented and sustained at managed sites.

  • Partnering across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Process Development, Operations, Global Distribution, and other functions to develop and communicate analyses, recommendations, and presentations to cross-functional and leadership audiences.

  • Serving as a supply chain representative for change controls, special projects, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

Key activities

Depending on the assigned product portfolio, program stage, site model, and functional ownership, the AXP Supply Chain Manager may carry out, coordinate, or support the following activities in accordance with established processes and procedures.

Production Planning

  • Establish and maintain applicable SAP and RapidResponse master data, including site, material, and BOM setup; change-control assessments; and planning parameters.

  • Collaborate with planning groups and CMOs to translate demand into executable production plans.

  • Plan and allocate supply across applicable manufacturing stages, including raw materials, intermediates, DS, DP, and/or FDP.

  • Monitor production schedules and coordinate resolution of risks to schedule adherence and supply continuity.

  • Conduct capacity analyses, identify constraints, and coordinate actions to support production ramp-up and supply readiness.

  • Execute production orders, material transfer orders, and purchase orders, and review and approve invoices, in accordance with established processes.

Raw Material Management

  • Support development and execution of internal and CMO raw material ordering strategies, including order quantities, delivery timing, and inventory or safety-stock considerations.

  • Partner with relevant Amgen functions and CMOs to assess raw material readiness, identify constraints, and coordinate resolution of supply risks.

  • Establish and maintain applicable raw material master data.

  • Manage or support raw material purchase orders, invoices, issue resolution, shipment coordination, and storage-space planning, as applicable.

Logistics and Storage Readiness

  • Identify shipment requirements and schedule needs with origin sites, destination sites, CMOs, and raw material vendors; coordinate shipment-readiness activities to support supply continuity.

  • Assess logistics and storage readiness, including storage capacity and warehouse readiness; identify constraints and coordinate resolution with Global Distribution, Quality, sites, and CMOs.

  • Identify needs for new or revised GMP shipping lanes and coordinate requests through Global Distribution processes.

  • Provide supply-chain input to the review of import/export documentation and coordinate issue resolution with Global Distribution, Trade Operations, Quality, sites, carriers, and CMOs, as applicable.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a go getter with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate Degree OR

  • Master's Degree + 2 years of Engineering, Business Management or Life Science OR

  • Bachelor's Degree + 4 years of Engineering, Business Management or Life Science OR

  • Associates Degree + 8 years of Engineering, Business Management or Life Science OR

  • High School Diploma/GED + 10 years of Engineering, Business Management or Life Science

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business Management, Life Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • Experience in a regulated manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or supply-chain environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in supply planning, capacity or inventory analysis, and risk management.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex cross-functional deliverables and influence outcomes in a matrix environment.

  • Experience working with CMOs, suppliers, or other external partners.

  • Experience with SAP and RapidResponse or comparable ERP and advanced-planning systems.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and facilitation skills.

  • Ability to develop and communicate recommendations to cross-functional and leadership audiences.

  • Experience with continuous-improvement tools, methodologies, and change management.

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives

raw.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify entrepreneurs’ and business owners’ financial lives. Underneath all our products is a massive web of partners that users don’t see, requiring significant product and process investment. That’s where the Financial Partnership Operations team comes in. We work to maintain our external relationships and streamline our collective workflows to keep customers, partners, and Mercury employees happy.

We’re looking for a Trading Operations Lead to own and scale the trading operations function powering Mercury’s SEC-registered investment advisor and FINRA-member broker-dealer. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with deep brokerage and trading operations expertise who can both set the standard for how the function operates and step directly into complex operational work when needed. This role is ideal for someone who has operated in a detail-rich, regulated environment, has strong opinions about what good trading operations looks like, communicates clearly across technical and non-technical teams, and wants the opportunity to build and evolve the function rather than simply inherit it.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the trading operations and supervisory framework, providing licensed principal oversight of order and trade activity across money market funds, mutual funds, ETFs, and fixed income; oversee operational controls, reconciliations, exceptions, and escalations, partnering closely with Engineering and Product on system-managed workflows and with our carrying broker and other investment partners to investigate issues, resolve breaks, and ensure trading activity operates within established procedures and supervisory requirements.
  • Own the trade surveillance and operational control framework, including licensed supervisory review where required, oversight of pre- and post-trade controls, best execution monitoring, trade breaks and errors, escalation and remediation, and evidence that required reviews and controls are operating as designed; coordinate with Financial Crimes on surveillance alerts, suspicious activity escalations, and shared monitoring obligations.
  • Own supervision of trading and order-flow reporting obligations, including CAT (all elements, including annual clock synchronization), CAIS, and TRACE, coordinating with our carrying broker and third-party reporting vendor; ensure timely and accurate compliance with SEC Rules 606 and 607 and FINRA Rule 6151, and provide supervisory review of customer account statements and trade confirmations.
  • Serve as the operational escalation point for trade errors, breaks, and settlement issues, coordinating investigation and resolution across Engineering, Product, Compliance, and our carrying and executing partners, assessing customer impact, and ensuring recurring issues result in appropriate process or control improvements.
  • Oversee trading-related books and records requirements, partnering with Engineering, Compliance, and our carrying broker to ensure required trade, order, allocation, and supervisory records are appropriately generated, retained, and retrievable.
  • Own and maintain trading operations procedures and contribute to applicable Written Supervisory Procedures, ensuring documented controls and supervisory practices remain aligned with how our products, systems, and partner relationships operate.
  • Lead trading operations readiness for regulatory exams, audits, and internal testing, including producing operational evidence, supporting responses, remediating findings, and translating identified gaps into sustainable process or system improvements.
  • Manage day-to-day operational relationships with our carrying broker, executing brokers, custodians, fund companies, and transfer agents, including escalations, service-level performance, issue resolution, and operational change management.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering on system-managed trading workflows and controls, bringing the operational and supervisory perspective to requirements, pressure-testing exceptions and edge cases, and ensuring appropriate operational readiness and oversight before launch, including post-launch operational testing to confirm controls perform as designed in production.

description: The Technical QA Manager is responsible for the technical direction, governance and continual improvement of quality engineering across the organisation’s delivery areas.

raw.title: Technical Quality Assurance Manager
raw.excerpt: The Technical QA Manager is responsible for the technical direction, governance and continual improvement of quality engineering across the organisation’s delivery areas.
raw.description:
The Technical QA Manager is responsible for the technical direction, governance and continual improvement of quality engineering across the organisation’s delivery areas.

The role defines and maintains the overarching test strategy and ensures that quality engineering practices are practical, risk-based and integrated throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

The Technical QA Manager provides direct technical leadership and support to QA Champions and Test Automation Engineers. The role ensures that team testing strategies, automation approaches, quality standards and release evidence are aligned, measurable and consistently applied.

The purpose of the Technical QA Manager role is to:

  • Define, communicate and maintain the organisational test strategy and supporting quality engineering standards.
  • Enable QA Champions to define and operate effective team and product-area testing strategies.
  • Provide technical direction to Test Automation Engineers on automation strategy, framework design, coding standards, CI/CD integration, reusable components, maintainability, diagnostics, test data and execution reliability.
  • Ensure automated test execution is embedded into delivery pipelines and provides fast, reliable and actionable feedback.
  • Align functional, integration, regression, non-functional and release validation with product, technical and delivery risk.
  • Strengthen developer ownership of testing while providing appropriate governance, coaching and assurance.
  • Ensure AI-generated testing assets and automation code are reviewed critically before use.
  • Defining expectations for pipeline triggers, test execution, quality controls, test-result publication, diagnostic information and failure feedback.
  • Ensuring pipeline automation is reliable, maintainable and proportionate to product and release risk.
  • Improve release confidence through clear, evidence-based quality and automation reporting.
  • Reduce avoidable rework, escaped defects, flaky tests and dependency on manual regression testing.

The Technical QA Manager should be able to:

  • Define and implement comprehensive, risk-based test strategies across multiple delivery areas.
  • Translate organisational quality objectives into practical engineering standards.
  • Demonstrate practical integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Define effective pipeline execution, result visibility and failure-feedback approaches.
  • Provide credible technical leadership on modern test automation frameworks.
  • Work effectively with Playwright or equivalent test automation technology.
  • Review and guide maintainable automation code.
  • Understand automation developed using C#, Java or an equivalent object-oriented language.
  • Understand functional, integration, regression, API, user-interface and relevant non-functional testing approaches.
  • Assess the suitability of automation at different levels of a system.
  • Review automation framework design, test architecture and reusable components.
  • Evaluate automation maintainability, test data, environment dependencies and execution reliability.
  • Identify flaky, duplicated, low-value or overly expensive automated tests.
  • Analyse quality and automation evidence to identify systemic risks and improvement priorities.
  • Understand risk management, risk identification and risk-based testing.
  • Coach and influence QA Champions, Test Automation Engineers, developers and delivery stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Challenge weak requirements, ineffective controls and poor automation practices constructively.
  • Use AI-assisted testing capabilities critically, with appropriate review, traceability and governance.

The successful candidate should have:

  • Strong experience in software quality assurance, test automation and quality engineering.
  • Experience providing technical leadership across complex software delivery environments using kaban methodology.
  • Demonstrable experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrable experience improving the reliability and feedback value of pipeline-based automated testing.
  • Proven ability to define, implement and govern testing strategies.
  • Experience supporting other quality roles in applying testing strategies within delivery teams.
  • Practical experience with a modern automation framework.
  • Preferable experience with Playwright and Selenium.
  • Practical coding capability in an object-oriented programming language.
  • Experience designing, building or significantly improving maintainable test automation frameworks.
  • Experience reviewing automation architecture and test-code quality.
  • A good understanding of functional, integration, regression and release testing.
  • A good understanding of software delivery lifecycle and release governance.
  • A good understanding of risk management, risk identification and risk-based testing.
  • A proactive and improvement-focused approach.
  • The confidence to challenge poor quality or automation practices constructively.

Desirable experience includes:

  • Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines.
  • Experience configuring automated test execution within build and deployment pipelines.
  • Experience publishing and interpreting automated test results within CI/CD tooling.
  • Experience implementing pipeline quality controls.

The Technical QA Manager should be measured on:

  • Adoption and effectiveness of organisational testing strategy.
  • Quality and consistency of team and product-area testing strategies.
  • Effectiveness of support provided to QA Champions.
  • Effectiveness of technical direction provided to Test Automation Engineers.
  • Reliable automated test execution within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Faster, clearer and more actionable quality feedback to delivery teams.
  • Increased useful automated coverage in areas of meaningful product risk.
  • Reduced flaky, duplicated and low-value automated tests.
  • Improved maintainability of automation frameworks and test code.
  • Reduced dependency on repeatable manual regression testing.
  • Reduced escaped defects and avoidable rework.
  • Improved developer ownership of testing and quality.
  • Improved compliance with agreed Definition of Done expectations and release control processes.
  • Clear and evidence-based release-readiness reporting.
  • Timely escalation of significant quality and automation risks.
  • Improved collaboration between QA Champions, Test Automation Engineers and developers.
  • Demonstrable improvement in release confidence and testing effectiveness.
  • Success should not be measured only by the volume of tests automated. Measures consider automation value, reliability, risk coverage, feedback speed, maintainability and model.

description: Bridgeway Benefit Technologies is seeking a Software Trainer to join our growing Professional Services organization.

raw.title: Software Trainer
raw.excerpt: Bridgeway Benefit Technologies is seeking a Software Trainer to join our growing Professional Services organization.
raw.description:
Bridgeway Benefit Technologies is seeking a Software Trainer to join our growing Professional Services organization. As a Software Trainer, you will be responsible for creating and conducting interactive classes for our customers using our proprietary enterprise benefits administration software. The software manages benefit fund calculations, eligibility, claims, and pension processing for the Taft-Hartley industry.

This is a high-ownership role — you'll take over customer-facing training from our Business Analysts, learning a complex, highly configurable product largely on your own and turning that expertise into curriculum for internal and external audiences.

You'll deliver live virtual training via Teams, adapting your approach to each customer's skill level and technical aptitude.

This is a remote position with about 25% travel across the U.S. and Canada; East Coast candidates are preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own customer-facing training end to end, acting as the primary point of contact for all training engagements.
  • Independently learn the product and each customer's configuration well enough to build and facilitate curriculum for internal teams and external customers, becoming a product subject matter expert.
  • Develop and maintain training materials — exercises, job aids, quick-reference guides, and process documentation.
  • Collaborate with leadership, product managers, and subject matter experts to keep the curriculum current with product changes, industry trends, and customer feedback.
  • Deliver customer-specific training, virtually and on-site, tailored to each customer's configuration and skill level.
  • Manage training schedules and deployment across customer accounts.
  • Gather feedback and performance data from training sessions and use it to continuously evaluate and refine content and delivery methods.
  • Consult with customers and internal teams on training scope and approach for projects with unique or complex requirements.

Requirements

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience delivering technology-based training to adult learners and developing curriculum.
  • A bachelor's degree in a related field.
  • Able to partner with subject matter experts, given the complexity and configurability of the software and range of customer environments.
  • Technical writing skills, with experience producing clear job aids, quick-reference guides, and process documentation for a technical or software audience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex software functionality clearly and engage individuals at all levels of an organization.
  • A proactive, self-motivated self-starter with a genuine passion for continuous learning and for improving processes and the customer experience, not just documenting them as-is.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple training engagements simultaneously.
  • Certification in training or learning and development is preferred.
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve productivity and deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and Smartsheet for developing training materials, presentations, and managing training schedules.

Bridgeway is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

About the role

As a Growth Engineer at Ritual, you will spearhead integration of Ritual’s cutting-edge AI infrastructure with partner applications and protocols, expanding the network's reach and impact. Your efforts will allow technology partners in the web3 space and beyond to take advantage of Ritual’s AI infrastructure stack, in creating novel, first-of-their-kind applications.

Extras
  • Experience deploying scalable, secure, high-performance infrastructure and applications on AWS/GCP, especially using infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform

Why join us

  • Top 1% of benefits across the web3 startup space

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career

Our solutions are best-in-breed and customers need a trusted cybersecurity partner who can create a truly zero-trust-based security architecture. Our customers are looking to us to create critical transformations and our portfolio of solutions will help us do that.

As a District Sales Manager, you will lead a team of field sellers and to help formulate and execute a strategy to maximize business growth. You are instrumental in developing and managing your team to generate revenue and achieve individual, team, and organizational quotas.

We are looking for a proven first-line sales leader with great energy, leadership, and initiative to drive team performance and revenue growth for our sales team.

  • Deeply understanding your customers’ needs by doing the research to develop insight into their priorities

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Experience with channel and partner sales models

  • Proven leader with the ability to create high performing teams in a rapidly growing sales environment.

  • Highly driven individual with an execution focus and a strong sense of urgency with an entrepreneurial mindset.

  • Excellent at influencing others, both externally and internally; ability to communicate effectively and build consensus across various functional groups to achieve goals.

  • You're a leader and you know that to get the best results, you also have to be a great team player, building excellent rapport and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$332,400.00 - $457,050.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

raw.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a People Operations Associate to join our team.

Position Description

Oklo is seeking a People Operations Associate to help support and scale the foundation of our People function. This role is ideal for someone who has developed an early HR career foundation and is ready to expand their impact by contributing to a broader range of people related functions.

The ideal candidate is Workday HRIS fluent and understands how to leverage the tool to drive company growth, can pick up new skills quickly, and lean into the multi-faceted aspects of this role. We are seeking someone who is located in the Eastern Standard Timezone.

Specific responsibilities may include:

HR Systems, Workday Administration & Process Excellence

  • Support day-to-day Workday administration, including employee transactions, organizational changes, data updates, and routine system maintenance
  • Maintain accurate employee and organizational data in Workday through regular audits, data validation, and issue resolution
  • Support Workday configuration, business process improvements, enhancements, integrations, and semiannual releases, including testing changes, documenting results, and identifying issues
  • Create and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, and analytics used by People Operations and leaders across the company
  • Troubleshoot routine Workday questions and transaction issues, escalating more complex configuration or technical issues as appropriate
  • Maintain Workday process documentation, job aids, and internal guidance to support consistent system use
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate People processes through Workday while improving system adoption, data quality, and reporting capabilities

HR & Talent Operations

  • Maintain accurate employee records and ensure data integrity across HR systems
  • Provide administrative support to the talent team by maintaining headcount tracking and scheduling
  • Serve as a point of contact for employee questions regarding HR programs, policies, and processes
  • Support organizational changes, transfers, and employee data updates
  • Assist with policy administration and employee communications

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Support compliance with federal, multi-state, and local employment laws and regulations
  • Co-manage I-9 administration, employee documentation, and audit readiness activities
  • Assist with leave administration, accommodations processes, and other compliance-related workflows
  • Monitor regulatory changes and help update policies and procedures accordingly
  • Partner with People leadership on compliance initiatives and process improvements

Reporting & Workforce Analytics

  • Develop and maintain recurring People metrics and dashboards
  • Analyze workforce trends related to headcount, turnover, recruiting, compensation, and employee engagement
  • Create ad hoc reports and presentations for leadership
  • Leverage Excel and reporting tools to provide actionable workforce insights
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency and data accuracy

Benefits & People Programs

  • Support benefits administration and employee enrollment processes
  • Assist with annual open enrollment and employee education efforts
  • Help coordinate employee programs, engagement initiatives, and People team projects
  • Support performance management and talent development processes as needed

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
  • 2+ years of HR, People Operations, HR Coordinator, HR Associate, or related experience
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using Workday as a primary HRIS.
  • Experience creating reports, auditing employee data, and supporting HR transactions within Workday.
  • Strong understanding of HR data management, reporting, and system governance.
  • Ability to navigate Workday independently with minimal training.
  • Located in Eastern timezone

Bonus Qualifications:

  • SHRM-CP or PHR certification (can be in progress)
  • Experience supporting multi-state employee populations
  • Experience in a technology, engineering, manufacturing, or high-growth startup environment
  • Greenhouse or similar ATS experience
  • Experience supporting benefits administration and employee relations processes
  • Experience creating dashboards and workforce analytics reports

Competencies

We are looking for a People Operations Associate that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Knowledgeable about Workday HRIS
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $85,000-$105,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.
